title.zh: 卷九十二 志第四十五 河渠二
title.raw: 卷九十二 志第四十五 河渠二 Volume 92 Treatises 45: Rivers and Canals 2

sentences.zh: 黃河 中

translations.literal: Yellow River (middle section)
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River (continued)

sentences.zh: 熙甯四年七月辛卯，北京新堤第四、第五埽決，漂溺館陶、永濟、清陽以北，遣茂則乘驛相視。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Xining, on the day xinmao, the fourth and fifth revetments of the new dike at Beijing broke; areas north of Guantao, Yongji, and Qingyang were flooded and drowned; Mao Ze was sent by express relay to inspect on site.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the seventh month in the fourth year of the Xining era, breaches opened at the fourth and fifth revetments of Beijing’s new dike, inundating the country north of Guantao, Yongji, and Qingyang. The court dispatched Mao Ze post-haste to survey the damage.

sentences.zh: 八月，河溢澶州曹村，十月，溢衛州王供。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the river overflowed at Caocun in Danzhou; in the tenth month it overflowed at Wanggong in Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the river spilled over at Caocun in Danzhou; by the tenth month it had also overflowed at Wanggong in Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 時新堤凡六埽，而決者二，下屬恩、冀，貫御河，奔沖為一。

translations.literal: At that time the new dike had six revetments in all, of which two had broken; downstream it belonged to En and Ji, cut through the Imperial Canal, and the rushing flood merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: The new dike then comprised six revetments, two of which had burst; below, the floodwaters linked En and Ji prefectures, pierced the Imperial Canal, and merged into a single torrent.

sentences.zh: 帝憂之，自秋迄冬，數遣使經營。

translations.literal: The emperor was troubled by it; from autumn through winter he repeatedly sent envoys to manage the works.
translations.idiomatic: Deeply troubled, the emperor sent envoy after envoy from autumn through winter to oversee remedial works.

sentences.zh: 是時，人爭言導河之利，茂則等謂：「二股河地最下，而舊防可因，今堙塞者才三十餘里，若度河之湍，浚而逆之，又存清水鎮河以析其勢，則悍者可回，決者可塞。」

translations.literal: At that time people all argued for the benefit of diverting the river; Mao Ze and others said: 'The Two-Channel River lies at the lowest ground, and the old defenses can be relied on; what is now blocked is only a little more than thirty li. If one gauges the river's rapids, dredges and turns them back, and also keeps the Qingshui Town River to split its force, then what is fierce can be turned back and what is breached can be stopped.'
translations.idiomatic: At the time many officials urged the benefits of channeling the Yellow River. Mao Ze and his colleagues argued, "The Two-Channel River occupied the lowest ground and old embankments could still be used: only a little over thirty li were silted shut. Measure the main current’s force, dredge and turn it back, and keep the Qingshui Town River open to divide the flow—then the violent current could be bent aside and the breaches closed."

sentences.zh: 帝然之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，令河北轉運司開修二股河上流，並修塞第五埽決口。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he ordered the Hebei Transport Commission to open and repair the upper reach of the Two-Channel River, and also to repair and close the breach at the fifth revetment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the court ordered the Hebei transport office to reopen the upper reach of the Two-Channel River and to seal the breach at the fifth revetment.

sentences.zh: 五年二月甲寅，興役，四月丁卯，二股河成，深十一尺，廣四百尺。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, on the day jiayin of the second month labor was mobilized; on the day dingmao of the fourth month the Two-Channel River was completed, eleven chi deep and four hundred chi wide.
translations.idiomatic: Labor began on jiayin day in the second month of the fifth year; by dingmao day in the fourth month the Two-Channel River was finished—eleven chi deep and four hundred chi wide.

sentences.zh: 方浚河則稍障其決水，至是，水入於河，而決口亦塞。

translations.literal: While the river was being dredged it slightly blocked the breach water; by then the water entered the channel, and the breach was also closed.
translations.idiomatic: Dredging had partly checked the flood from the breach; once the channel was ready, the water returned to the riverbed and the breach was sealed as well.

sentences.zh: 六月，河溢北京夏津。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the river overflowed at Xiajin in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the river flooded Xiajin in the Beijing circuit.

sentences.zh: 閏七月辛卯，帝語執政：「聞京東調夫修河，有壞產者，河北調急夫尤多；

translations.literal: On the intercalary seventh month, day xinmao, the emperor spoke to the chief ministers: 'I hear that in Jingdong corvée laborers are being levied to repair the river and some have had their property ruined; in Hebei urgent labor drafts are especially numerous;
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day in the intercalary seventh month the emperor told his chief ministers, "I hear that Jingdong is drafting men to repair the river and that some households have lost their livelihoods; Hebei is pressing even more men into emergency corvée;

sentences.zh: 若河復決，奈何？

translations.literal: if the river breaks again, what then?
translations.idiomatic: if the river bursts again, what are we to do?

sentences.zh: 且河決不過占一河之地，或西或東，若利害無所校，聽其所趨，如何？」

translations.literal: Moreover a river breach occupies no more than one river's width of land, whether west or east; if benefit and harm are not weighed against each other, and it is allowed to go where it will, how would that be?'
translations.idiomatic: Besides, a breach only claims the width of one channel, east or west. If we stop weighing costs against benefits and simply let the river go where it wishes, what do you think of that?"

sentences.zh: 王安石曰：「北流不塞，占公私田至多，又水散漫，久復澱塞。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said: 'If the northern current is not blocked, it will occupy a great deal of public and private farmland; moreover the water spreads diffusely and in time will silt up again.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi replied, "If we do not block the northern current, it will engulf vast tracts of public and private farmland. The water will spread aimlessly and eventually silt up again.

sentences.zh: 昨修二股，費至少而公私田皆出，向之瀉鹵，俱為沃壤，庸非利乎。

translations.literal: When the two channels were repaired yesterday the expense was very small yet public and private fields all emerged; what had been saline waste all became fertile soil—is this not a benefit?
translations.idiomatic: Repairing the two channels cost little, yet public and private fields reappeared and former salt flats turned into rich soil—is that not a clear gain?

sentences.zh: 況急夫已減於去歲，若復葺理堤防，則河北歲夫愈減矣。」

translations.literal: Moreover urgent labor drafts are already fewer than last year; if the dikes are again maintained and repaired, then Hebei's annual corvée will decrease still further.'
translations.idiomatic: Urgent labor drafts are already lower than last year; if we keep the dikes in repair, Hebei's annual corvée burden should shrink further still."

sentences.zh: 六年四月，始置疏浚黃河司。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, fourth month, the Office for Dredging the Yellow River was first established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year the court created the Yellow River Dredging Office.

sentences.zh: 先是，有選人李公義者，獻鐵龍爪揚泥車法以浚河。

translations.literal: Earlier, a candidate for office named Li Gongyi presented a method of iron dragon-claw mud-lifting carts for dredging the river.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier a minor official named Li Gongyi had proposed dredging with iron “dragon-claw” mud-lifting carts towed along the channel.

sentences.zh: 其法：用鐵數斤為爪形，以繩系舟尾而沈之水，篙工急棹，乘流相繼而下，一再過，水已深數尺。

translations.literal: The method: several jin of iron were made into claw shapes, tied with rope to the stern of a boat and sunk in the water; the boatmen rowed hard, riding the current in succession downstream; after one or two passes the water was already several chi deeper.
translations.idiomatic: Several pounds of iron were forged into claws, roped to a boat’s stern and dragged underwater while oarsmen rowed hard downstream. One or two passes could deepen the channel by several chi.

sentences.zh: 宦官黃懷信以為可用，而患其太輕。

translations.literal: The eunuch Huang Huaixin thought it could be used but worried that it was too light.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Huang Huaixin judged the device workable but feared it was too light.

sentences.zh: 王安石請令懷信、公義同議增損，乃別制浚川杷。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi requested that Huaixin and Gongyi jointly discuss additions and reductions, and then a separate River-Dredging Rake was devised.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi had Huang Huaixin and Li Gongyi revise the design together, producing a separate “river-dredging rake.”

sentences.zh: 其法：以巨木長八尺，齒長二尺，列於木下如杷狀，以石壓之；

translations.literal: The method: a huge timber eight chi long, with teeth two chi long, arranged beneath the timber like a rake, weighted with stone;
translations.idiomatic: The new tool used an eight-chi beam with two-chi teeth set beneath like a rake and weighted with stone;

sentences.zh: 兩旁系大繩，兩端矴大船，相距八十步，各用滑車絞之，去來撓蕩泥沙，已又移船而浚。

translations.literal: large ropes were tied on both sides, and at both ends large boats were moored eighty paces apart; each used a pulley to wind it, going back and forth to stir up silt and sand, then moving the boats to dredge again.
translations.idiomatic: heavy ropes ran to large boats moored eighty paces apart; capstans hauled the rake back and forth to scour silt, then the boats shifted position to continue dredging.

sentences.zh: 或渭水深則杷不能及底，雖數往來無益；

translations.literal: Some said that when the water was deep the rake could not reach the bottom, and though it went back and forth many times it was of no use;
translations.idiomatic: Critics noted that in deep water the rake never reached the bottom, so repeated passes accomplished nothing;

sentences.zh: 水淺則齒礙沙泥，曳之不動，卒乃反齒向上而曳之。

translations.literal: when the water was shallow the teeth caught in sand and mud and could not be dragged; in the end they turned the teeth upward and dragged it that way.
translations.idiomatic: in shallow water the teeth snagged in mud and would not budge, so crews finally flipped the teeth upward and dragged it that way instead.

sentences.zh: 人皆知不可用，惟安石善其法，使懷信先試之以浚二股，又謀鑿直河數里以觀其效。

translations.literal: Everyone knew it could not be used, but only Anshi favored the method; he had Huaixin first test it to dredge the two channels, and also planned to cut a straight river several li to observe its effect.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone else saw the rake as useless, but Wang Anshi alone championed it. He had Huang Huaixin trial it on the two channels and planned to cut a straight channel several li long to test its performance.

sentences.zh: 且言於帝曰：「開直河則水勢分。

translations.literal: He also said to the emperor: 'Opening a straight river will divide the water's force.
translations.idiomatic: He told the emperor, "Cutting a straight channel will split the current.

sentences.zh: 其不可開者，以近河，每開數尺即見水，不容施功爾。

translations.literal: What cannot be opened is because it is near the river; every time several chi are dug water appears, and work cannot be applied.
translations.idiomatic: The reason ordinary excavation fails is proximity to the river—dig a few chi and water appears, leaving no room to work.

sentences.zh: 今第見水即以杷浚之，水當隨杷改趨直河，苟置數千杷，則諸河淺澱，皆非所患，歲可省開浚之費幾百千萬。」

translations.literal: Now whenever water is seen, use the rake to dredge it; the water should follow the rake and turn toward the straight river. If several thousand rakes are set out, then shallow silt in all rivers will no longer be a worry, and each year the expense of opening and dredging can be saved by several million.'
translations.idiomatic: But wherever water appears, deploy the rake; the current should follow it into the straight channel. Thousands of rakes would clear shallow silt everywhere and save millions in annual dredging costs."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「果爾，甚善。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'If it is really so, that is very good.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "If that proves true, it would be excellent.

sentences.zh: 聞河北小軍壘當起夫五千，計合境之丁，僅及此數，一夫至用錢八緡。

translations.literal: I hear that for the small military stockades in Hebei five thousand laborers are to be levied; counting all adult males in the circuit, they barely reach this number, and for one laborer as much as eight strings of cash are spent.
translations.idiomatic: I hear Hebei’s small garrison posts must levy five thousand laborers—barely the circuit’s entire adult male quota—and each man costs up to eight strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 故歐陽修嘗謂開河如放火，不開如失火，與其勞人，不如勿開。」

translations.literal: Therefore Ouyang Xiu once said that opening a river is like setting a fire, and not opening it is like losing a fire; rather than exhausting the people, it is better not to open it.'
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Xiu once said that opening a river is like lighting a fire, while leaving it closed is like letting a fire burn unchecked—better not to open it than to exhaust the people."

sentences.zh: 安石曰：「勞人以除害，所謂毒天下之民而從之者。」

translations.literal: Anshi said: 'To exhaust the people in order to remove harm is what is called harming the people of the realm yet having them follow.'
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi replied, "To burden the people in order to remove a greater harm is what the sages meant by 'harming the people of the realm yet winning their obedience.'"

sentences.zh: 帝乃許春首興工，而賞懷信以度僧牒十五道，公義與堂除；

translations.literal: The emperor then permitted work to begin at the start of spring, and rewarded Huaixin with fifteen ordination certificates for monks; Gongyi received a direct appointment in the Hall;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved work to begin that spring, rewarded Huang Huaixin with fifteen ordination certificates, and gave Li Gongyi a direct appointment at court;

sentences.zh: 以杷法下北京，令虞部員外郎、都大提舉大名府界金堤範子淵與通判、知縣共試驗之，皆言不可用。

translations.literal: the rake method was sent down to Beijing; Fan Ziyuan, Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and Grand Intendant of the Golden Dike in the Daming Prefecture circuit, was ordered together with vice-prefects and magistrates jointly to test it; all said it could not be used.
translations.idiomatic: The rake method was sent to Beijing for trial by Fan Ziyuan—vice director of works and chief intendant of the Daming circuit Golden Dike—together with prefectural and county officials; all reported it unusable.

sentences.zh: 會子淵以事至京師，安石問其故，子淵意附會，遽曰：「法誠善，第同官議不合耳。」

translations.literal: When Ziyuan came to the capital on business, Anshi asked the reason; Ziyuan, intending to agree, promptly said: 'The method is indeed good; it is only that my colleagues' opinions do not agree.'
translations.idiomatic: When Fan Ziyuan came to the capital on other business, Wang Anshi asked why the trials failed. Seeking to please him, Fan Ziyuan said at once, "The method is sound; my colleagues simply disagreed."

sentences.zh: 安石大悅。

translations.literal: Anshi was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi was delighted.

sentences.zh: 至是，乃置浚河司，將自衛州浚至海口，差子淵都大提舉，公義為之屬。

translations.literal: At this point the River-Dredging Office was established, planning to dredge from Weizhou to the sea mouth; Ziyuan was appointed Grand Intendant, and Gongyi served under him.
translations.idiomatic: The River-Dredging Office was then established to dredge from Weizhou to the sea. Fan Ziyuan was named chief intendant and Li Gongyi his deputy.

sentences.zh: 許不拘常制，舉使臣等；

translations.literal: He was permitted not to be bound by regular regulations in recommending commissioners and the like;
translations.idiomatic: He was authorized to recommend commissioners without normal procedural limits;

sentences.zh: 人船、木鐵、工匠，皆取之諸埽；

translations.literal: men, boats, timber, iron, and craftsmen were all taken from the various revetments;
translations.idiomatic: laborers, boats, timber, iron, and craftsmen were all drawn from the revetment posts;

sentences.zh: 官吏奉給視都水監丞司；

translations.literal: officials' salaries and allowances were treated the same as those of the Directorate of Waterways assistant commissioners;
translations.idiomatic: official salaries matched those of Directorate of Waterways assistant commissioners;

sentences.zh: 行移與監司敵體。

translations.literal: his documents and orders were on a par with those of circuit intendants.
translations.idiomatic: and his orders carried equal weight with those of circuit supervisors.

sentences.zh: 當是時，北流閉已數年，水或橫決散漫，常虞壅遏。

translations.literal: At that time the northern current had been closed for several years; the water sometimes broke out laterally and spread diffusely, and there was constant fear of blockage.
translations.idiomatic: By then the northern current had been shut off for years; the river sometimes burst sideways and spread widely, and officials constantly feared blockage.

sentences.zh: 十月、外監丞王令圖獻議，於北京第四、第五埽等處開修直河，使大河還二股故道，乃命範子淵及朱仲立領其事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Outer Assistant Commissioner Wang Lingtu presented a proposal to open and repair a straight river at the fourth and fifth revetments of Beijing and elsewhere, so that the great river would return to the old course of the two channels; Fan Ziyuan and Zhu Zhongli were then ordered to lead the work.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Outer Assistant Commissioner Wang Lingtu proposed opening a straight channel at Beijing’s fourth and fifth revetments to return the main river to the two-channel old course. Fan Ziyuan and Zhu Zhongli were placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 〈原文此處訛亂，據並行紀事校補〉開直河深八尺，引水入二股故道，又浚二股、清水鎮河，凡退水處皆閉之。

translations.literal: [Source text corrupt; parallel editions read:] The straight river was opened eight chi deep, water was led into the old course of the two channels, the Two-Channel River and the Qingshui Town River were also dredged, and wherever floodwater had retreated, the openings were all closed.
translations.idiomatic: [The received text here is corrupt in all editions; following parallel accounts:] They opened a straight channel eight chi deep, directed water into the two-channel old course, dredged the Two-Channel River and the Qingshui Town River, and sealed every place where the flood had withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 七年，都水監丞劉璯言：「自開直河，閉魚肋，水勢增漲，行流湍急，漸塌河岸，而許家港、清水鎮河極淺漫，幾於不流。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Assistant Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways Liu Yan said: 'Since the straight river was opened and the Fish-Rib [channel] was closed, the water's force has increased and risen; the flowing current is swift and urgent and is gradually collapsing the river banks, while Xujia Harbor and the Qingshui Town River are extremely shallow and spread out, almost ceasing to flow.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Assistant Commissioner Liu Yan reported, "Since the straight channel was opened and the Fish-Rib outlet closed, the current has grown stronger and faster, eroding the banks, while Xujia Harbor and the Qingshui Town River have become so shallow and slack they barely flow.

sentences.zh: 雖二股深快，而蒲泊已東，下至四界首，退出之田，略無固護，設遇漫水出岸，牽回河頭，將復成水患。

translations.literal: Although the two channels are deep and fast, east of Pubo, down to the Four-Boundary Head, the fields that the river has abandoned have scarcely any solid protection; if floodwater should overflow the banks, it would draw the river head back and again become a water disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Though the two channels run deep and swift, east of Pubo down to the Four-Boundary Head the fields the river has left behind lack solid protection. Should floodwater spill over the banks, it could pull the channel back and bring disaster again.

sentences.zh: 宜候霜降水落，閉清水鎮河，築縷河堤一道以遏漲水，使大河復循故道。

translations.literal: It is fitting to wait until frost falls and the water subsides, close the Qingshui Town River, build one thread-river dike to check the rising water, and make the great river again follow the old course.
translations.idiomatic: We should wait until autumn frost lowers the water, close the Qingshui Town River, build a thread-river dike to hold back the flood, and return the main current to its old course.

sentences.zh: 又退出良田數萬頃，俾民耕種。

translations.literal: Moreover tens of thousands of qing of good fields that the river has abandoned would be made available for the people to cultivate.
translations.idiomatic: Tens of thousands of qing of fertile land the river had abandoned could then be farmed again.

sentences.zh: 而博州界堂邑等退背七埽，歲減修護之費，公私兩濟。」

translations.literal: Moreover in Bozhou circuit the seven revetments behind Tangyi and elsewhere would each year reduce repair and maintenance costs, benefiting both public and private interests.'
translations.idiomatic: In Bozhou the seven revetments behind Tangyi and similar sites would save annual maintenance costs, benefiting both state and people alike."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 是秋，判大名文彥博言：「河溢壞民田，多者六十村，戶至萬七千，少者九村，戶至四千六百，願蠲租稅。」

translations.literal: That autumn, Wen Yanbo, acting prefect of Daming, said: 'The river overflow has ruined the people's fields; in the worst case sixty villages, with households reaching seventeen thousand; in the least nine villages, with households reaching four thousand six hundred. I request that rent and tax be remitted.'
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Wen Yanbo, chief official at Daming, reported, "Flooding has ruined farmland in as many as sixty villages affecting seventeen thousand households, and in the least nine villages with four thousand six hundred households. I ask that rents and taxes be remitted."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 又命都水詰官吏不以水災聞者。

translations.literal: He also ordered the Directorate of Waterways to investigate officials who did not report flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: The court also ordered the Directorate of Waterways to discipline officials who failed to report flood damage.

sentences.zh: 外都水監丞程昉以憂死。

translations.literal: Outer Assistant Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways Cheng Fang died from worry.
translations.idiomatic: Outer Assistant Commissioner Cheng Fang died of anxiety over the crisis.

sentences.zh: 十月，安石去位，吳充為相。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Anshi left office and Wu Chong became chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Wang Anshi left office and Wu Chong became chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 十年五月，滎澤河堤急，詔判都水監俞光往治之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year the Yongze River dike was urgent; Yu Guang, acting director of the Directorate of Waterways, was ordered to go and repair it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year the Yongze River dike was in crisis; Yu Guang, acting director of the Directorate of Waterways, was sent to repair it.

sentences.zh: 是歲七月，河復溢衛州王供及汲縣上下埽、懷州黃沁、滑州韓村；

translations.literal: In the seventh month of that year the river again overflowed at Wanggong in Weizhou and at the upper and lower revetments in Jixian, at Huangqin in Huazhou, and at Hancun in Huazhou;
translations.idiomatic: That seventh month the river flooded again at Wanggong in Weizhou, the upper and lower revetments in Jixian, Huangqin in Huazhou, and Hancun in Huazhou;

sentences.zh: 已醜，遂大決于澶州曹村，澶淵北流斷絕，河道南徙，東匯于梁山、張澤濼，分為二派，一合南清河入於淮，一合北清河入於海，凡灌郡縣四十五，而濮、齊、鄆、徐尤甚，壞田逾三十萬頃。

translations.literal: on the day jichou it then broke out greatly at Caocun in Danzhou; the northern current at Chanyuan was cut off, the river course shifted south, and in the east it gathered at Liangshan and Zhangze Marsh, dividing into two branches—one joining the Southern Clear River to enter the Huai, one joining the Northern Clear River to enter the sea—in all inundating forty-five prefectures and counties, while Pu, Qi, Yun, and Xu were especially hard hit, with more than three hundred thousand qing of fields ruined.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day a catastrophic breach opened at Caocun in Danzhou. The northern current at Chanyuan was cut off as the channel shifted south, pooling east at Liangshan and Zhangze Marsh and splitting in two—one branch joining the Southern Clear River to the Huai, the other the Northern Clear River to the sea. Forty-five prefectures and counties were inundated, Pu, Qi, Yun, and Xu suffering worst, with more than three hundred thousand qing of farmland destroyed.

sentences.zh: 遣使修閉。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to repair and close the breach.
translations.idiomatic: The court dispatched envoys to repair and close the breach.

sentences.zh: 八月，又決鄭州滎澤。

translations.literal: In the eighth month it broke again at Yongze in Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the river breached again at Yongze in Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 於是文彥博言：「臣正月嘗奏：德州河底淤澱，泄水稽滯，上流必至壅遏。

translations.literal: Thereupon Wen Yanbo said: 'Your subject in the first month once memorialized: the river bottom at Dezhou is silted and deposited, drainage is slow and delayed, and the upper reach will necessarily become blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yanbo then memorialized, "I reported in the first month that the riverbed at Dezhou was silting up, slowing drainage and inevitably backing up the upper reach.

sentences.zh: 又河勢變移，四散漫流，兩岸俱被水患，若不預為經制，必溢魏、博、恩、澶等州之境。

translations.literal: Moreover the river's force shifts and moves, spreading in all directions in diffuse flow; both banks alike suffer flood harm. If measures are not planned in advance, it will certainly overflow into the territories of Wei, Bo, En, Dan, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The channel keeps shifting and spreading in every direction, flooding both banks. Without advance planning it will surely spill into Wei, Bo, En, Dan, and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 而都水略無施設，止固護東流北岸而已。

translations.literal: Yet the Directorate of Waterways has scarcely any measures, only reinforcing the north bank of the eastern current.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Directorate of Waterways has done almost nothing beyond shoring up the north bank of the eastern current.

sentences.zh: 適累年河流低下，官吏希省費之賞，未嘗增修堤岸，大名諸埽，皆可憂虞。

translations.literal: Just at this time, for successive years the river has run low; officials hope for rewards for saving expense and have never increased or repaired the dikes; all the revetments of Daming are cause for worry.
translations.idiomatic: For years the river has run low while officials chase rewards for cutting costs and never strengthen the dikes—all of Daming’s revetments are cause for alarm.

sentences.zh: 謂如曹村一埽，自熙寧八年至今三年，雖每計春料當培低怯，而有司未嘗如約，其埽兵又皆給他役，實在者十有七八。

translations.literal: Take for example the Caocun revetment: from the eighth year of Xining until now, three years, although each year spring materials are budgeted to raise low and weak places, the responsible offices have never kept to the agreement; the revetment soldiers are all assigned to other labor, and those actually present are only seven or eight out of ten.
translations.idiomatic: Take Caocun revetment: for three years since the eighth year of Xining, spring budgets called for raising weak spots, yet officials never followed through. Revetment troops were diverted to other duties, leaving only seven or eight men in ten on site.

sentences.zh: 今者果大決溢，此非天災，實人力不至也。

translations.literal: Now it has indeed broken out in a great breach; this is not a disaster from Heaven but truly because human effort did not reach the task.
translations.idiomatic: The great breach we see today is not heaven’s disaster but human failure.

sentences.zh: 臣前論此，並乞審擇水官。

translations.literal: Your subject previously discussed this and also begged that water officials be carefully selected.
translations.idiomatic: I raised this before and asked that water officials be chosen with care.

sentences.zh: 今河朔、京東州縣，人被患者莫知其數，嗷嗷籲天，上軫聖念，而水官不能自訟，猶汲汲希賞。

translations.literal: Now in the prefectures and counties of Heshuo and Jingdong, the number of people who have suffered harm is beyond knowing; they cry out to Heaven, and Your Majesty's compassionate concern is deeply moved—yet the water officials cannot plead guilty for themselves and still eagerly hope for rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Across Heshuo and Jingdong countless people suffer, crying to heaven while Your Majesty grieves—yet water officials refuse to admit fault and still chase rewards.

sentences.zh: 臣前論所陳，出於至誠，本圖補報，非敢激訐也。」

translations.literal: What your subject previously discussed and presented came from utmost sincerity; the basic aim was to make amends and repay favor, and I do not dare to provoke accusation.'
translations.idiomatic: My earlier warnings were offered in full sincerity, seeking only to serve the throne—not to provoke quarrels."

sentences.zh: 元豐元年四月丙寅，決口塞，詔改曹村埽曰靈平。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfeng, fourth month, day bingyin, the breach was closed; an edict changed the name of the Caocun Revetment to Lingping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the fourth month of the first year of Yuanfeng, the breach was closed, and the court renamed the Caocun Revetment Lingping.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌，新堤成，閉口斷流，河復歸北。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, day jiaxu, the new dike was completed; the opening was closed and the flow cut off, and the river again returned north.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the fifth month, the new dike was finished; the opening was sealed, the flow was cut off, and the river returned to its northern course.

sentences.zh: 初議塞河也，故道堙而高，水不得下，議者欲自夏津縣東開簽河入董固以護舊河，袤七十里九十步；

translations.literal: When closing the river was first discussed, the old channel was silted up and high, so the water could not descend; the discussants wanted to open a qian river east from Xiajin County into Donggu to protect the old river, extending 70 li and 90 paces;
translations.idiomatic: When the plan to close the river was first debated, the old channel had silted up so high that the water could not drain. Officials proposed opening a qian channel east of Xiajin County into Donggu to protect the old river, a length of 70 li and 90 paces;

sentences.zh: 又自張村埽直東築堤至龐家莊古堤，袤五十里二百步。

translations.literal: they also proposed building a dike straight east from Zhangcun Revetment to the old dike at Pangjiazhuang, extending 50 li and 200 paces.
translations.idiomatic: they also proposed building a dike straight east from Zhangcun Revetment to the old dike at Pangjiazhuang, a length of 50 li and 200 paces.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密都承旨韓縝相視。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Han Zhen, Chief Recipient of Orders of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to inspect it.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Han Zhen, Chief Recipient of Orders of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to inspect the site.

sentences.zh: 縝言：「漲水沖刷新河，已成河道。

translations.literal: Zhen said: 'The swollen water has scoured the new river, and it has already become a river channel.
translations.idiomatic: Han Zhen reported, "Floodwater has already scoured the new river into a channel.

sentences.zh: 河勢變移無常，雖開河就堤，及于河身創立生堤，枉費功力。

translations.literal: The river's force shifts and changes without constancy; even if a river is opened to meet the dike, or a new living dike is established in the river body, labor and expense will be wasted.
translations.idiomatic: The river's course shifts unpredictably, so opening a channel to meet the dike or building a fresh dike within the river itself would waste labor and resources.

sentences.zh: 惟增修新河，乃能經久。」

translations.literal: Only by augmenting and repairing the new river can it endure for long.'
translations.idiomatic: Only strengthening and repairing the new river can make the work last."

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: The edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 十一月，都水監言：「自曹村決溢，諸埽無復儲蓄，乞給錢二十萬緡下諸路，以時市梢草封樁。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Directorate of Waterways said: 'Since the breach and overflow at Caocun, the revetments no longer have stored supplies; we beg that two hundred thousand strings of cash be issued to the various circuits to buy fascine and straw in season for sealing and piling.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Directorate of Waterways reported, "Since the breach and overflow at Caocun, the revetments no longer have reserves. We request two hundred thousand strings of cash for the circuits to buy fascines and straw for emergency repairs."

sentences.zh: 詔給十萬緡，非朝旨及埽岸危急，毋得擅用。

translations.literal: An edict granted one hundred thousand strings; except on court order or when revetment banks were critically urgent, they were not to be used without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted one hundred thousand strings, to be spent only on imperial order or when a revetment was in imminent danger.

sentences.zh: 二年七月戊子，範子淵言：「因護黃河岸畢工，乞中分為兩埽。」

translations.literal: In the second year, seventh month, day wuzi, Fan Ziyuan said: 'Because the work of protecting the Yellow River bank is completed, I beg that it be divided in the middle into two revetments.'
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the seventh month of the second year Fan Ziyuan reported, "Because work protecting the Yellow River bank is finished, we ask that it be split into two revetments."

sentences.zh: 詔以廣武上、下埽為名。

translations.literal: An edict named them the Upper and Lower Guangwu revetments.
translations.idiomatic: The court named them the Upper and Lower Guangwu revetments.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，澶州孫村、陳埽及大吳、小吳埽決，詔外監丞司速修閉。

translations.literal: In the third year, seventh month, the Sun Village, Chen revetment, and Great Wu and Little Wu revetments broke in Danzhou; the Outer Assistant Commissioner offices were ordered to repair and close them quickly.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year breaches opened at Sun Village, Chen revetment, and the Great and Little Wu revetments in Danzhou; outer assistant commissioners were ordered to repair them at once.

sentences.zh: 初，河決澶州也，北外監丞陳祐甫謂：「商胡決三十餘年，所行河道，填淤漸高，堤防歲增，未免氾濫。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the river broke at Danzhou, Northern Outer Assistant Commissioner Chen Youfu said: 'Since the Shanghu breach more than thirty years ago, the channel that has been followed has been filled and silted and has gradually risen; dikes are increased year by year, yet flooding cannot be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: When the river first broke at Danzhou, Northern Outer Assistant Commissioner Chen Youfu argued, "Since the Shanghu breach thirty years earlier the active channel has silted higher year by year despite ever-taller dikes, flooding remains inevitable.

sentences.zh: 今當修者有三：商胡一也，橫壟二也，禹舊跡三也。

translations.literal: What should now be repaired has three: Shanghu is the first, Henglong the second, and Yu's old trace the third.
translations.idiomatic: Three courses might be restored: Shanghu first, Henglong second, and Yu’s old channel third.

sentences.zh: 然商胡、橫壟故道，地勢高平，土性疏惡，皆不可復，復亦不能持久。

translations.literal: Yet the old courses of Shanghu and Henglong have high, level terrain and poor, loose soil; none can be restored, and even if restored they could not last.
translations.idiomatic: But the Shanghu and Henglong old courses lie on high, level ground with loose, poor soil—they cannot be restored, nor would restoration last.

sentences.zh: 惟禹故瀆尚存，在大伾、太行之間，地卑而勢固。

translations.literal: Only Yu's old channel still exists, between Great Pi and the Taihang range; the ground is low and the configuration firm.
translations.idiomatic: Only Yu’s old channel remains, between Great Pi and the Taihang Mountains—low ground with a firm configuration.

sentences.zh: 故秘閣校理李垂與今知深州孫民先皆有修復之議。

translations.literal: Former Secretariat Collator Li Chui and the present prefect of Shenzhou Sun Minxian both have proposals to restore it.
translations.idiomatic: Former Secretariat collator Li Chui and the current prefect of Shenzhou Sun Minxian have both proposed restoring it.

sentences.zh: 望召民先同河北漕臣一員，自衛州王供埽按視，訖於海口。」

translations.literal: I hope that Minxian may be summoned together with one Hebei transport official to inspect on site from the Wanggong revetment in Weizhou to the sea mouth.'
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Sun Minxian be summoned with a Hebei transport official to survey from the Wanggong revetment in Weizhou to the sea mouth."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，小吳埽復大決，自澶注入御河，恩州危甚。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, fourth month, the Little Wu revetment again broke out greatly; from Danzhou it entered the Imperial Canal, and Enzhou was in extreme danger.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year the Little Wu revetment burst again, sending floodwater from Danzhou into the Imperial Canal and putting Enzhou in grave peril.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，詔：「東流已填淤不可復，將來更不修閉小吳決口，候見大河歸納，應合修立堤防，令李立之經畫以聞。」

translations.literal: On the day wuwu of the sixth month an edict said: 'The eastern current has been filled and silted and cannot be restored; in future the Little Wu breach will no longer be repaired and closed. When the great river is seen to return and be received, wherever dikes should be built and established, have Li Lizhi plan and report.'
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the sixth month an edict declared, "The eastern current is silted beyond recovery and the Little Wu breach will no longer be closed. Once the main river settles, Li Lizhi is to plan any needed dikes and report."

sentences.zh: 帝謂輔臣曰：「河之為患久矣，後世以事治水，故常有礙。

translations.literal: The emperor said to the chief ministers: 'The river's harm has been long; later ages treat water according to circumstances in governing it, and therefore there are often obstacles.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his ministers, "Floods have plagued us for ages. Later generations tried to control the river piecemeal, which is why the problem never ends.

sentences.zh: 夫水之趨下，乃其性也，以道治水，則無違其性可也。

translations.literal: Water's running downward is its nature; to govern water by the Way is then not to violate its nature.
translations.idiomatic: Water naturally flows downward. Govern it by the Way and you do not fight its nature.

sentences.zh: 如能順水所向，遷徙城邑以避之，復有何患？

translations.literal: If one can follow where the water wishes to go and move cities and towns to avoid it, what further harm would there be?
translations.idiomatic: If we follow where the water wishes to go and relocate towns out of its path, what further harm remains?

sentences.zh: 雖神禹復生，不過如此。」

translations.literal: Even if divine Yu were reborn, he could do no more than this.'
translations.idiomatic: Even if Yu the Great were reborn, he could do no more than this."

sentences.zh: 輔臣皆曰：「誠如聖訓。」

translations.literal: The chief ministers all said: 'It is truly as Your Sagely Instruction states.'
translations.idiomatic: The ministers replied, "Your sagely teaching is entirely correct."

sentences.zh: 河北東路提點刑獄劉定言：「王莽河一徑水，自大名界下合大流注冀州，及臨清徐曲御河決口、恩州趙村壩子決口兩徑水，亦注冀州城東。

translations.literal: Liu Ding, Hebei East Circuit Judicial Intendant, said: 'The Wang Mang River forms one branch of water; from below the Daming border it joins the great current and flows into Jizhou. Together with the two branches from the Linqing Xuchu Imperial Canal breach and the Zhaocun Dam breach in Enzhou, they also pour into the east of Jizhou city.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei East Circuit judicial intendant Liu Ding warned, "The Wang Mang River forms one stream joining the main current into Jizhou from below Daming, while breaches at Linqing Xuchu on the Imperial Canal and at Zhaocun Dam in Enzhou send two more streams into the east of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 若遂成河道，即大流難以西傾，全與李垂、孫民先所論違背，望早經制。」

translations.literal: If they become river channels, then the great current will be hard to tilt westward, entirely contrary to what Li Chui and Sun Minxian discussed; I hope measures will be taken early.'
translations.idiomatic: If these become permanent channels the main current cannot be turned west again, contradicting Li Chui and Sun Minxian’s plan entirely. I urge early intervention."

sentences.zh: 詔送李立之。

translations.literal: An edict forwarded this to Li Lizhi.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was forwarded to Li Lizhi.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，立之言：「臣自決口相視河流，至乾寧軍分入東、西兩塘，次入界河，於劈地口入海，通流無阻，宜修立東西堤。」

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the eighth month Lizhi said: 'Your subject inspected the river from the breach; at Qianning Army it divided into the eastern and western ponds, then entered the Border River, and at Pedi Mouth entered the sea; the flow passes without obstruction. Eastern and western dikes should be built and established.'
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the eighth month Li Lizhi reported, "From the breach the river ran to Qianning Army, split into eastern and western ponds, entered the Border River, and reached the sea at Pedi Mouth without obstruction. Eastern and western dikes should be built and established."

sentences.zh: 詔覆計之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered a review and estimate.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered a review and cost estimate.

sentences.zh: 而言者又請：「自王供埽上添修南岸，于小吳口北創修遙堤，候將來礬山水下，決王供埽，使直河注東北，於滄州界或南或北，從故道入海。」

translations.literal: But memorializers also requested: 'From the Wanggong revetment add repair to the south bank; north of the Little Wu mouth create and repair a distant dike; wait until the alum-mountain waters come down in future, breach the Wanggong revetment, and make the straight river pour northeast; at the Cangzhou border, whether south or north, follow the old course to enter the sea.'
translations.idiomatic: Others proposed, "From Wanggong revetment, raise the south bank; north of Little Wu mouth, build a distant dike; when alum-mountain floodwaters come, breach Wanggong and send a straight channel northeast to re-enter the sea north or south of Cangzhou along the old course."

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: This was not followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court did not approve.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，立之又言：「北京南樂、館陶、宗城、魏縣，淺口、永濟、延安鎮，瀛州景城鎮，在大河兩堤之間，乞相度遷於堤外。」

translations.literal: On the day gengzi of the ninth month Lizhi again said: 'Nanle, Guantao, Zongcheng, and Weixian of Beijing, Qian Kou, Yongji, and Yan'an Town, and Jingcheng Town of Yingzhou lie between the two dikes of the great river; I beg that they be surveyed and moved outside the dikes.'
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the ninth month Li Lizhi added, "Nanle, Guantao, Zongcheng, Weixian, Qian Kou, Yongji, Yan’an Town, and Jingcheng Town in Yingzhou all lie between the river’s two dikes. We ask that they be surveyed for relocation beyond the embankments."

sentences.zh: 於是用其說，分立東西兩堤五十九埽。

translations.literal: Thereupon his proposal was adopted; eastern and western dikes were separately established with fifty-nine revetments.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted his plan, establishing fifty-nine revetments along separate eastern and western dikes.

sentences.zh: 定三等向著：河勢正著堤身為第一，河勢順流堤下為第二，河離堤一里內為第三。

translations.literal: Three grades were fixed for facing-toward conditions: where the river course pressed directly on the dike body was first; where the river course ran downstream along the foot of the dike was second; where the river lay within one li of the dike was third.
translations.idiomatic: Three grades were established for when the river bore toward the bank: the first applied when the current pressed straight against the dike; the second when it ran downstream along the toe of the embankment; the third when the water lay within one li of the dike.

sentences.zh: 退背亦三等：堤去河最遠為第一，次遠者為第二，次近一里以上為第三。

translations.literal: For retreating-away conditions there were also three grades: the dike farthest from the river was first; the next farther was second; the next nearer but still more than one li away was third.
translations.idiomatic: Three corresponding grades were set for when the river had pulled back: first when the dike stood farthest from the channel; second at the next remove; third when the gap was still more than one li.

sentences.zh: 立之在熙甯初已主立堤，今竟行其言。

translations.literal: Lizhi at the beginning of the Xining era had already advocated building dikes; now his words were finally carried out in full.
translations.idiomatic: As early as the opening years of the Xining reign, Lizhi had urged building levees; now his policy was put fully into practice.

sentences.zh: 五年正月己丑，詔立之：「凡為小吳決口所立堤防，可按河勢向背應置埽處，毋虛設巡河官，毋橫費工料。」

translations.literal: In the fifth year, first month, day jichou, an edict to Lizhi stated: "For all dikes and defenses erected because of the Xiaowu breach, yang revetments may be placed according to whether the river course faces toward or retreats away; do not vainly appoint river-patrol officials; do not squander labor and materials recklessly."
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the first month of the fifth year, the throne addressed Lizhi: "For every levee raised at the Xiaowu breach, set yang revetments only where the river's orientation toward or away from the bank requires them; do not post river patrol officers where they serve no purpose, and do not waste labor and supplies."

sentences.zh: 六月，河溢北京內黃埽。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Yellow River overflowed at the Neihuang yang in the Northern Capital circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the river topped the Neihuang yang revetment in the Northern Capital region.

sentences.zh: 七月，決大吳埽堤，以紓靈平下埽危急。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Great Wu yang dike was breached, to relieve the critical danger at the Lingping Lower yang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the court deliberately cut the Great Wu yang levee to ease the crisis threatening the Lingping Lower yang.

sentences.zh: 八月，河決鄭州原武埽，溢入利津、陽武溝、刀馬河，歸納梁山濼。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the river broke through at the Yuanwu yang in Zhengzhou, overflowed into the Lijin, Yangwu Canal, and Daoma River, and returned into the Liangshan marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the river burst the Yuanwu yang at Zhengzhou, spilled into the Lijin, Yangwu Canal, and Daoma River, and flowed back into the Liangshan marshland.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「原武決口已引奪大河四分以上，不大治之，將貽朝廷巨憂。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "The Yuanwu breach has already drawn off more than four-tenths of the main river; if it is not vigorously repaired, it will leave the court a grave worry.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "The Yuanwu breach has already diverted more than four-tenths of the main current; unless it is repaired on a large scale, the court will face a major calamity.

sentences.zh: 其輟修汴河堤岸司兵五千，並力築堤修閉。」

translations.literal: Let the five thousand soldiers of the Bian River Dike and Bank Office engaged in repairs be halted and combined to build dikes and close the breach with full force."
translations.idiomatic: Suspend the five thousand troops of the Bian River Dike Office from their usual work and concentrate them on building levees and sealing the breach."

sentences.zh: 都水復言：「兩馬頭墊落，水面闊二十五步，天寒，乞候來春施工。」

translations.literal: The Directorate of Waterworks reported again: "Both horse-head spurs have subsided; the water surface is twenty-five paces wide; the weather is cold—we beg to wait until next spring to carry out the work."
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterworks replied: "Both horse-head spurs have settled; the channel is twenty-five paces wide; the cold season makes work impossible—we ask to defer construction until spring."

sentences.zh: 至臘月竟塞雲。

translations.literal: By the twelfth month the breach was finally sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Nevertheless, by the twelfth month the breach had been closed.

sentences.zh: 九月，河溢滄州南皮上、下埽，又溢清池埽，又溢永靜軍阜城下埽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the river overflowed the Upper and Lower yang at Nanpi in Cangzhou, then overflowed the Qingchi yang, then overflowed the Fucheng Lower yang in Yongjing Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the river topped the upper and lower Nanpi yangs in Cangzhou, then the Qingchi yang, then the Fucheng Lower yang in Yongjing Commandery.

sentences.zh: 十月辛亥，提舉汴河堤岸司言：「洛口廣武埽大河水漲，塌岸，壞下閘斗門，萬一入汴，人力無以枝梧。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day xinhai, the office in charge of the Bian River dikes reported: "At the Guangwu yang at Luokou the Yellow River has risen, the bank has collapsed, and the lower sluice gate is broken; if the water should enter the Bian Canal, human strength could not withstand it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the tenth month, the Bian River Dike Office reported: "At the Guangwu yang near Luokou the main river has swollen, the bank has caved in, and the lower gate is ruined; should the flood enter the Bian Canal, no amount of labor could hold it back.

sentences.zh: 密邇都城，可不深慮。」

translations.literal: It lies close to the capital—how can we not give it deep thought?"
translations.idiomatic: It lies hard by the capital; the court cannot take the risk lightly."

sentences.zh: 詔都水監官速往護之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the supervising officials of the Directorate of Waterworks to go quickly and protect the site.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered waterworks supervisors to hurry there and shore up the works.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，廣武上、下埽危急，詔救護，尋獲安定。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Upper and Lower Guangwu yang were in critical danger; an edict ordered rescue, and before long they were secured.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day the upper and lower Guangwu yangs were in peril; the court ordered emergency repairs, and they were soon stabilized.

sentences.zh: 七年七月，河溢元城埽，決橫堤，破北京。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, seventh month, the river overflowed the Yuancheng yang, broke the cross dike, and breached the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, seventh month, the river topped the Yuancheng yang, burst the transverse levee, and flooded the Northern Capital region.

sentences.zh: 帥臣王拱辰言：「河水暴至，數十萬眾號叫求救，而錢谷稟轉運，常平歸提舉，軍器工匠隸提刑，埽岸物料兵卒即屬都水監，逐司在遠，無一得專，倉卒何以濟民？

translations.literal: The commander Wang Gongchen said: "The flood waters surged in; hundreds of thousands cried out for rescue, yet funds and grain must be requested from the transport commissioner, Ever-Normal Granaries belong to the intendant, arms and craftsmen fall under the judicial commissioner, and yang-bank materials, troops, and laborers belong to the Directorate of Waterworks—each agency is distant and none may act on its own; in an emergency how can the people be saved?
translations.idiomatic: Commander Wang Gongchen memorialized: "When the flood struck, hundreds of thousands cried for help, yet funds and grain require the transport commissioner, Ever-Normal reserves answer to the intendant, arms and artisans to the judicial commissioner, and yang materials, troops, and labor to the waterworks directorate—each office is remote and none may decide alone; in a crisis how can the people be aided?

sentences.zh: 望許不拘常制。」

translations.literal: We hope to be allowed not to be bound by regular regulations."
translations.idiomatic: I ask permission to act outside the usual rules."

sentences.zh: 詔：「事幹機速，奏覆牒稟所屬不及者，如所請。」

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Where affairs touch urgent timing and memorial reply or dispatch to one's superior cannot keep pace, grant what is requested."
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied: "Where speed is essential and reporting or consulting superiors cannot keep pace, grant the request."

sentences.zh: 戊申，命拯護陽武埽。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Zheng was ordered to protect the Yangwu yang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Zheng was ordered to defend the Yangwu yang.

sentences.zh: 十月，冀州王令圖奏：「大河行流散漫，河內殊無緊流，旋生灘磧。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Wang Lingtu of Jizhou memorialized: "The main river flows in a scattered course; within the channel there is virtually no concentrated current, and shoals and bars form at once.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Wang Lingtu of Jizhou reported: "The Yellow River runs in a diffuse course; there is scarcely a main channel left, and bars and shoals keep forming.

sentences.zh: 宜近澶州相視水勢，使還復故道。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to inspect the water conditions near Dazhou and make the river return to its old course.
translations.idiomatic: The court should survey the flow near Dazhou and guide the river back to its former course."

sentences.zh: 會明年春，宮車晏駕。

translations.literal: Just then, in the spring of the following year, the imperial carriage halted forever.
translations.idiomatic: But in the spring of the following year the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 大抵熙甯初，專欲導東流，閉北流。

translations.literal: Broadly speaking, at the beginning of Xining the aim was solely to guide the eastern flow and close the northern flow.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly speaking, in the early Xining years the court sought only to force the river east and shut off the northern channel.

sentences.zh: 元豐以後，因河決而北，議者始欲復禹故跡。

translations.literal: After the Yuanfeng era, because the river broke northward, advocates began to wish to restore Yu's old trace.
translations.idiomatic: After the Yuanfeng period, once breaches drove the river north, officials began calling for a return to Yu the Great's ancient course.

sentences.zh: 神宗愛惜民力，思順水性，而水官難其人。

translations.literal: Shenzong cherished the people's strength and thought to follow the water's nature, yet among water officials the right man was hard to find.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong wished to spare the people and work with the river's nature, but he could find no water commissioner equal to the task.

sentences.zh: 王安石力主程昉、範子淵，故二人尤以河事自任；

translations.literal: Wang Anshi strongly backed Cheng Fang and Fan Ziyuan, so the two men especially took the river work upon themselves;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi strongly backed Cheng Fang and Fan Ziyuan, and the two men in turn made the river their personal charge;

sentences.zh: 帝雖藉其才，然每抑之。

translations.literal: the emperor, though relying on their talent, yet restrained them each time.
translations.idiomatic: yet though the emperor used their abilities, he repeatedly held them in check.

sentences.zh: 其後，元祐元年，子淵已改司農少卿，御史呂陶劾其「修堤開河，縻費巨萬，護堤壓埽之人，溺死無數。

translations.literal: Later, in the first year of Yuanyou, Ziyuan had already been transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Granaries; the censor Lü Tao impeached him, saying: "In repairing dikes and opening channels, he tied up vast expense; of those who pressed yang revetments to protect the dikes, countless drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Later, in Yuanyou 1, Ziyuan had become vice minister of the imperial granaries when Censor Lü Tao impeached him: "His dike repairs and channel digging consumed vast sums, and countless laborers pressing yang revetments under him drowned.

sentences.zh: 元豐六年興役，至七年功用不成。

translations.literal: Labor was raised in the sixth year of Yuanfeng; by the seventh year the work had not succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Works begun in the sixth year of Yuanfeng were still unfinished in the seventh year of Yuanfeng.

sentences.zh: 乞行廢放。」

translations.literal: I beg that the project be abolished and abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the project be abandoned."

sentences.zh: 於是黜知兗州，尋降知峽州。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was demoted to prefect of Yanzhou, and soon further reduced to prefect of Xiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to prefect of Yanzhou, then soon reduced further to prefect of Xiazhou.

sentences.zh: 其制略曰：「汝以有限之材，興必不可成之役，驅無辜之民，置之必死之地。」

translations.literal: The edict in summary said: "You, with limited ability, raised labor that could not possibly succeed, drove innocent people, and placed them where they must die."
translations.idiomatic: The dismissal edict read in part: "With your limited talent you launched a work that could not succeed, drove innocent people, and sent them to certain death."

sentences.zh: 中書舍人蘇軾詞也。

translations.literal: The wording was by Su Shi, Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: Su Shi, as secretariat drafter, had composed the text.

sentences.zh: 八年三月，哲宗即位，宣仁聖烈皇后垂簾。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eighth year, Zhezong took the throne and the Empress Dowager Xuanren held the curtain and ruled.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eighth year Zhezong ascended the throne and Empress Dowager Xuanren assumed the regency.

sentences.zh: 河流雖北，而孫村低下，夏、秋霖雨，漲水往往東出。

translations.literal: Although the river course lay to the north, Suncun was low; in summer and autumn rains the swollen waters often issued eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Though the main channel ran north, the low ground at Suncun meant that summer and autumn rains often sent floodwaters eastward.

sentences.zh: 小吳之決既未塞，十月，又決大名之小張口，河北諸郡皆被水災。

translations.literal: The Xiaowu breach had still not been sealed; in the tenth month the Xiaozhangkou at Daming broke again, and all the prefectures of Hebei suffered flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiaowu breach remained open; in the tenth month the Xiaozhangkou at Daming broke as well, and flood disaster spread across Hebei.

sentences.zh: 知澶州王令圖建議浚迎陽埽舊河，又于孫村金堤置約，復故道。

translations.literal: Wang Lingtu, prefect of Dazhou, proposed dredging the old channel at the Yingyang yang and also placing a choke at the Jindi at Suncun to restore the old course.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lingtu, prefect of Dazhou, urged dredging the old channel at the Yingyang yang and setting a choke on the Jindi levee at Suncun to restore the former course.

sentences.zh: 本路轉運使範子奇仍請于大吳北岸修進鋸牙，擗約河勢。

translations.literal: The transport commissioner of this circuit, Fan Ziqi, still requested building advancing saw-teeth works on the north bank at Dawu to split and check the river's force.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit transport commissioner Fan Ziqi also asked to build sawtooth spur dikes on the north bank at Dawu to divert the current.

sentences.zh: 於是回河東流之議起。

translations.literal: Thereupon the proposal to turn the river back to an eastern flow arose.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the debate to turn the Yellow River east again began.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年二月乙丑，詔：「未得雨澤，權罷修河，放諸路兵夫。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanyou, second month, day yichou, an edict stated: "Rain blessings have not yet been received; for the time being suspend river repairs and release the labor troops of all circuits."
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the second month of Yuanyou 1 an edict declared: "Rain has not yet come; suspend river works for now and release labor troops on all circuits."

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，詔秘書監張問相度河北水事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day dingchou, an edict ordered Zhang Wen of the Secretariat to survey Hebei water affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the ninth month the court ordered Zhang Wen of the Secretariat to survey Hebei's water problems.

sentences.zh: 十月庚寅，又以王令圖領都水，同問行河。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, day gengyin, Wang Lingtu was again put in charge of the Directorate of Waterworks to travel the river together with Wen.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the tenth month Wang Lingtu was placed at the head of the waterworks directorate to inspect the river with Wen.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，問言：「臣至滑州決口相視，迎陽埽至大、小吳，水勢低下，舊河淤仰，故道難復。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, day bingzi, Wen said: "When I reached the breach at Huazhou to inspect, from the Yingyang yang to the Great and Little Wu, the water level was low and the old channel was silted and raised— the old course is hard to restore.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the eleventh month Wen reported: "At the Huazhou breach, from the Yingyang yang to the Great and Little Wu, the water lies low and the old bed is silted up—the former course cannot be restored.

sentences.zh: 請于南樂大名埽開直河並簽河，分引水勢入孫村口，以解北京向下水患。」

translations.literal: I request opening a straight channel and a branch channel at the Nanle-Daming yang to divide the water force into the mouth at Suncun, to relieve the downstream flood trouble of the Northern Capital."
translations.idiomatic: I propose cutting a straight channel and a branch channel at the Nanle-Daming yang to divert flow into Suncun and ease flooding below the Northern Capital."

sentences.zh: 令圖亦以為然，於是減水河之議復起。

translations.literal: Lingtu also considered it right; thereupon the proposal for a flood-relief channel arose again.
translations.idiomatic: Lingtu agreed, and the plan for a flood-relief channel was revived.

sentences.zh: 既從之矣，會北京留守韓絳奏引河近府非是，詔問別相視。

translations.literal: After the court had approved it, the Northern Capital's resident defender Han Jiang memorialized that drawing the river near the prefectural seat was wrong; an edict ordered Wen to survey again separately.
translations.idiomatic: The court had already approved the plan when Han Jiang, resident defender of the Northern Capital, objected that drawing the river near the city was unwise; Wen was ordered to survey again.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，令圖、問欲必行前說，朝廷又從之。

translations.literal: In the second year, second month, Lingtu and Wen wished to press the earlier plan through; the court again followed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, second month, Lingtu and Wen pressed their original plan, and the court again assented.

sentences.zh: 三月，令圖死，以王孝先代領都水，亦請如令圖議。

translations.literal: In the third month Lingtu died; Wang Xiaoxian was put in his place to head the Directorate of Waterworks and also requested proceeding as in Lingtu's plan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Lingtu died; Wang Xiaoxian succeeded him at the waterworks directorate and likewise urged adopting Lingtu's plan.

sentences.zh: 右司諫王覿言：「河北人戶轉徙者多，朝廷責郡縣以安集，空倉廩以振濟，又遣專使察視之，恩德厚矣。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrance Wang Di said: "Many households in Hebei have moved away; the court has charged the prefectures and counties to settle them, emptied granaries to give relief, and also sent special envoys to inspect—the grace is already deep.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Wang Di said: "Many Hebei families have been displaced; the court has ordered prefectures to resettle them, emptied granaries for relief, and sent special inspectors—the grace shown is already great.

sentences.zh: 然耕耘是時，而流轉于道路者不已；

translations.literal: Yet it is the season for plowing and hoeing, while those wandering on the roads do not cease;
translations.idiomatic: Yet it is planting season, and people still wander the roads;

sentences.zh: 二麥將熟，而寓食于四方者未還。

translations.literal: the second crop of wheat is about to ripen, yet those lodging and eating in distant places have not returned.
translations.idiomatic: the second wheat crop is nearly ripe, yet refugees living abroad have not come home.

sentences.zh: 其故何也，盍亦治其本矣。

translations.literal: What is the reason? Why not also treat the root cause?
translations.idiomatic: Why is this? The court should address the root cause as well.

sentences.zh: 今河之為患三：氾濫渟滀，漫無涯涘，吞食民田，未見窮已，一也；

translations.literal: Now the river's harms are three: widespread flooding and stagnant pooling, boundless in extent, devouring the people's fields with no end in sight— the first;
translations.idiomatic: The river now inflicts three harms. First, endless flooding and standing water devour farmland without limit;

sentences.zh: 緣邊漕運獨賴御河，今御河淤澱，轉輸艱梗，二也；

translations.literal: border transport relies solely on the Imperial Canal; now the Imperial Canal is silted and clogged, and transport is painfully obstructed— the second;
translations.idiomatic: second, frontier transport depends on the Imperial Canal, which is now silted and choked;

sentences.zh: 塘泊之設，以限南北，濁水所經，即為平陸，三也。

translations.literal: the pond-marshes were established to mark off north and south; wherever muddy water passes, it becomes level land— the third.
translations.idiomatic: third, the pond-marshes were meant to divide north from south, but wherever muddy water flows it turns them into flat land.

sentences.zh: 欲治三患，在遴擇都水、轉運而責成耳。

translations.literal: To treat the three harms lies in selecting the Directorate of Waterworks and transport officials and holding them responsible.
translations.idiomatic: To cure these three ills the court need only choose capable waterworks and transport officials and hold them accountable.

sentences.zh: 今轉運使範子奇反覆求合，都水使者王孝先暗繆，望別擇人。」

translations.literal: Now the transport commissioner Fan Ziqi repeatedly seeks to curry favor, and the waterworks commissioner Wang Xiaoxian is muddled and confused—I hope others may be chosen."
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ziqi, the transport commissioner, keeps shifting to please whichever side prevails, and Wang Xiaoxian, the waterworks commissioner, is incompetent. I urge the court to appoint others."

sentences.zh: 時知樞密院事安燾深以東流為是，兩疏言：「朝廷久議回河，獨憚勞費，不顧大患。

translations.literal: At the time An Tuo, who knew the affairs of the Bureau of Military Affairs, deeply held that an eastern flow was correct; in two memorials he said: "The court has long debated turning the river back, yet fears only labor and expense and does not heed the great calamity.
translations.idiomatic: An Tuo, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, strongly favored turning the river east and wrote twice: "The court has debated restoring the eastern course for years, yet shrinks from the cost and ignores the greater disaster.

sentences.zh: 蓋自小吳未決以前，河入海之地雖屢變移，而盡在中國；

translations.literal: For before the Xiaowu breach, although the place where the river entered the sea shifted repeatedly, it lay entirely within the Middle Kingdom;
translations.idiomatic: Before the Xiaowu breach, although the river's mouth shifted often, it always lay within our territory;

sentences.zh: 故京師恃以北限強敵，景德澶淵之事可驗也。

translations.literal: thus the capital relied on it to mark the northern limit against a powerful foe—the affair of Jingde and Chanyuan can verify this.
translations.idiomatic: so the capital could rely on the river as a northern barrier against powerful enemies, as the Chanyuan settlement of the Jingde era shows.

sentences.zh: 且河決每西，則河尾每北，河流既益西決，固已北抵境上。

translations.literal: Moreover, whenever the river broke westward, its tail shifted northward; now that the river has increasingly broken west, it has already pressed north to the border.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, each westward breach pushes the river's tail northward; with repeated western breaks, the channel has already reached our northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 若復不止，則南岸遂屬遼界，彼必為橋樑，守以州郡；

translations.literal: if it does not stop, the south bank will belong to the Liao frontier; they will surely build bridges and guard it with prefectures and districts;
translations.idiomatic: If this continues, the south bank will fall within Liao territory; they will build bridges and garrison it with prefectures;

sentences.zh: 如慶曆中因取河南熟戶之地，遂築軍以窺河外，已然之效如此。

translations.literal: as in the Qingli era, when by taking the lands of registered households south of the river they then built armies to peer beyond the river—the effect already accomplished was thus.
translations.idiomatic: just as in the Qingli era they seized lands of registered households south of the river and built garrisons to watch beyond it—a precedent already proven.

sentences.zh: 蓋自河而南，地勢平衍，直抵京師，長慮卻顧，可為寒心。

translations.literal: For south of the river the terrain is level and open, running straight to the capital; long thought and backward glance can make one shudder.
translations.idiomatic: South of the river the land is flat and open all the way to the capital; the prospect is enough to make one tremble.

sentences.zh: 又朝廷捐東南之利，半以宿河北重兵，備預之意深矣。

translations.literal: Moreover, the court has surrendered half the profits of the southeast to quarter heavy troops in Hebei—the intent to prepare defenses runs deep.
translations.idiomatic: The court already sacrifices half the southeast's revenue to station heavy forces in Hebei—a deep commitment to frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 使敵能至河南，則邈不相及。

translations.literal: If the enemy could reach the region south of the river, then they would be far beyond reach.
translations.idiomatic: If the enemy could reach the lands south of the river, our defenses would be left far behind.

sentences.zh: 今欲便於治河而緩於設險，非計也。」

translations.literal: Now to seek convenience in managing the river while slackening in setting defenses is not a plan."
translations.idiomatic: To ease river works while neglecting strategic defenses is no policy at all."

sentences.zh: 王岩叟亦言：「朝廷知河流為北道之患日深，故遣使命水官相視便利，欲順而導之，以拯一路生靈於墊溺，甚大惠也。

translations.literal: Wang Yansou also said: "The court knows that the river course is daily becoming a deeper calamity for the northern route, and therefore sent envoys ordering water officials to survey what is advantageous, wishing to follow and guide it, to rescue the living souls of a whole circuit from drowning in the mire—a very great grace.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yansou also wrote: "The court knows the river grows daily more dangerous to the northern frontier, and sent officials to survey how best to guide it and save an entire circuit from drowning—a great act of grace.

sentences.zh: 然昔者專使未還，不知何疑而先罷議；

translations.literal: Yet formerly, before the special envoy had returned, for what doubt was the debate first halted;
translations.idiomatic: Yet while the envoy was still abroad, some doubt led the court to halt the plan;

sentences.zh: 專使反命，不知何所取信而議復興。

translations.literal: when the special envoy reported back, on what was trust placed that the debate revived?
translations.idiomatic: when he returned, on what grounds was the debate revived?

sentences.zh: 既敕都水使者總護役事，調兵起工，有定日矣，已而復罷。

translations.literal: An edict had already ordered the waterworks commissioner to oversee the labor in chief, mobilize troops, and raise works, with a fixed day set—then it was halted again.
translations.idiomatic: The court had ordered the waterworks commissioner to oversee the project, mobilized troops, and set a start date—then halted it again.

sentences.zh: 數十日間，變議者再三，何以示四方？

translations.literal: Within several tens of days the deliberation was changed again and again—how is this to be shown to the four quarters?
translations.idiomatic: Within weeks the policy shifted repeatedly—what message does this send the realm?

sentences.zh: 今有大害七，不可不早為計。

translations.literal: Now there are seven great harms; one cannot fail to plan early.
translations.idiomatic: Seven grave dangers now demand urgent planning.

sentences.zh: 北塞之所恃以為險者在塘泊，黃河堙之，猝不可浚，浸失北塞險固之利，一也。

translations.literal: What the northern frontier relies on for its strategic barrier is the pond-marshes; the Yellow River buries them and they cannot quickly be dredged—gradually the strategic advantage of the northern frontier's strong defenses is lost: the first.
translations.idiomatic: First, the northern frontier depends on the pond-marshes for defense; the Yellow River is burying them beyond quick repair, eroding that strategic advantage.

sentences.zh: 橫遏西山之水，不得順流而下，蹙溢於千里，使百萬生齒，居無廬，耕無田，流散而不復，二也。

translations.literal: It blocks crosswise the waters of the western hills so they cannot flow down smoothly, squeezing overflow for a thousand li, so that a million lives have no house to dwell in and no field to plow, scattering and not returning: the second.
translations.idiomatic: Second, it dams the western hill streams so they cannot drain, flooding a thousand li and leaving a million people homeless, landless, and scattered without return.

sentences.zh: 乾甯孤壘，危絕不足道，而大名、深、冀腹心郡縣，皆有終不自保之勢，三也。

translations.literal: The lone fortress of Qianning is perilous in the extreme and hardly worth mention, yet the heartland prefectures of Daming, Shen, and Ji all have the look of ultimately being unable to protect themselves: the third.
translations.idiomatic: Third, though the isolated fortress of Qianning is barely defensible, the core prefectures of Daming, Shen, and Ji all face the prospect of being unable to hold out.

sentences.zh: 滄州扼北敵海道，自河不東流，滄州在河之南，直抵京師，無有限隔，四也。

translations.literal: Cangzhou strangles the northern enemy's sea route; since the river does not flow east, Cangzhou lies south of the river, running straight to the capital with no limiting barrier: the fourth.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, Cangzhou guards the enemy's sea route northward; with the river no longer flowing east, Cangzhou lies south of the channel with nothing between it and the capital.

sentences.zh: 併吞御河，邊城失轉輸之便，五也。

translations.literal: It swallows up the Imperial Canal, and the border cities lose the convenience of transport: the fifth.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, it has engulfed the Imperial Canal, depriving border cities of transport.

sentences.zh: 河北轉運司歲耗財用，陷租賦以百萬計，六也。

translations.literal: The Hebei transport office yearly exhausts funds, with tax revenues lost reckoned in the millions: the sixth.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, the Hebei transport office loses millions in revenue each year.

sentences.zh: 六七月之間，河流交漲，占沒西路，阻絕遼使，進退不能，兩朝以為憂，七也。

translations.literal: Between the sixth and seventh months the rivers rise together, occupy and drown the western route, block the Liao envoys so they cannot advance or retreat, and both courts take it as a worry: the seventh.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, in summer the swollen rivers flood the western route, trapping Liao envoys so neither court can travel—a worry to both dynasties.

sentences.zh: 非此七害，委之可，緩而未治可也。

translations.literal: Were it not suited for these seven harms, one might leave the matter alone or be slow and not yet repair it.
translations.idiomatic: Without these seven harms, delay might be tolerable.

sentences.zh: 且去歲之患，已甚前歲，今歲又甚焉，則奈何？

translations.literal: Moreover, last year's calamity was already worse than the year before; this year is worse still—what then is to be done?
translations.idiomatic: Last year's disaster already exceeded the year before, and this year is worse still—what will the court do?

sentences.zh: 望深詔執政大臣，早決河議而責成之。」

translations.literal: I hope the court will deeply charge the chief ministers to decide the river debate early and hold them responsible for completion."
translations.idiomatic: I urge the throne to command the chief ministers to settle the river policy at once and hold them accountable."

sentences.zh: 太師文彥博、中書侍郎呂大防皆主其說。

translations.literal: Grand Mentor Wen Yanbo and Vice Director of the Secretariat Lü Dafang both upheld his view.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Mentor Wen Yanbo and Vice Director Lü Dafang both supported him.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人蘇轍謂右僕射呂公著曰：「河決而北，先帝不能回，而諸公欲回之，是自謂智勇勢力過先帝也。

translations.literal: Secretariat Drafter Su Zhe said to Right Vice Director Lü Gongzhu: "The river broke and went north; the late emperor could not turn it back, yet you gentlemen wish to turn it back—this is to claim that your wisdom, courage, and power surpass the late emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat drafter Su Zhe told Right Vice Director Lü Gongzhu: "When the river broke northward, the late emperor could not turn it back; if you gentlemen succeed, you claim wisdom, courage, and power greater than his.

sentences.zh: 盍因其舊而修其未備乎？」

translations.literal: Why not follow its present course and repair what is not yet complete?"
translations.idiomatic: Why not accept the present course and repair what remains unfinished?"

sentences.zh: 公著唯唯。

translations.literal: Gongzhu murmured assent.
translations.idiomatic: Gongzhu murmured noncommittal agreement.

sentences.zh: 於是三省奏：「自河北決，恩、冀以下數州被患，至今未見開修的確利害，致妨興工。」

translations.literal: Thereupon the Three Departments memorialized: "Since the breach in Hebei, several prefectures from En onward have suffered disaster; to this day the clear benefit and harm of opening and repairing has not been seen, causing obstruction to raising works."
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments then reported: "Since the Hebei breaches, several prefectures from En southward have suffered flood damage, yet the clear costs and benefits of any repair plan remain unsettled, blocking work from starting."

sentences.zh: 乃詔河北轉運使、副，限兩月同水官講議聞奏。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered the Hebei transport commissioner and vice commissioner, within two months, together with water officials to discuss the plan and report by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the Hebei transport commissioner and his deputy, together with water officials, to deliberate within two months and report back.

sentences.zh: 十一月，講議官皆言：「令圖、問相度開河，取水入孫村口還復故道處，測量得流分尺寸，取引不過，其說難行。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, all the discussing officials said: "Where Lingtu and Wen surveyed opening a channel to draw water into the mouth at Suncun to restore the old course, measurements of the divided flow in dimensions showed the draw would not suffice—the plan is hard to carry out."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the deliberating officials agreed: "Lingtu and Wen's plan to divert water into Suncun and restore the old course cannot draw enough flow by measurement—the scheme will not work."

sentences.zh: 十二月，張景先復以問說為善，果欲回河，惟北京已上、滑州而下為宜，仍于孫村浚治橫河舊堤，止用逐埽人兵、物料，並年例客軍，春天漸為之可也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Zhang Jingxian again held Wen's plan to be good; he truly wished to turn the river back, holding that only from above the Northern Capital to below Huazhou was suitable; still, at Suncun the old cross-river dike should be dredged and repaired, using only the men, troops, and materials of the successive yang stations together with the annual guest troops—doing it gradually in spring would do.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Zhang Jingxian again endorsed Wen's plan and urged turning the river back, but only between the Northern Capital upstream and Huazhou downstream; he proposed dredging the old cross-river levee at Suncun using only local yang labor, materials, and the usual guest troops, with work proceeding gradually in spring.

sentences.zh: 朝廷是其說。

translations.literal: The court approved his view.
translations.idiomatic: The court accepted his proposal.

sentences.zh: 三年六月戊戌，乃詔：「黃河未復故道，終為河北之患。

translations.literal: In the third year, sixth month, day wuxu, an edict stated: "The Yellow River has not returned to its old course; in the end it will remain a calamity for Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the sixth month of the third year an edict declared: "Until the Yellow River returns to its old course, Hebei will never be secure.

sentences.zh: 王孝先等所議，已嘗興役，不可中罷，宜接續工料，向去決要回復故道。

translations.literal: What Wang Xiaoxian and others discussed has already once raised labor; it cannot be halted midway—materials and work should be continued, and going forward it is resolved that the old course must be restored.
translations.idiomatic: The plan of Wang Xiaoxian and others has already been started and must not be abandoned midway; supplies and labor should continue until the old course is restored.

sentences.zh: 三省、樞密院速與商議施行。」

translations.literal: Let the Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs quickly consult and put it into effect."
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs should consult at once and implement it."

sentences.zh: 右相範純仁言：「聖人有三寶：曰慈，曰儉，曰不敢為天下先。
