translations.literal: Right Chancellor Fan Chunren said: "The sage has three treasures: they are called compassion, frugality, and not daring to put oneself ahead of all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Right Chancellor Fan Chunren said: "The sage holds three treasures: compassion, frugality, and not daring to place oneself ahead of all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 蓋天下大勢，惟人君所向，群下競趨如川流山摧，小失其道，非一言一力可回，故居上者不可不謹也。

translations.literal: For the great tendency of all under Heaven follows only where the ruler turns; the multitude below races after like a river's flow or a mountain's collapse—a small departure from the right path cannot be turned back by a single word or a single force; therefore one who dwells above must be cautious.
translations.idiomatic: The realm's momentum follows wherever the ruler turns; officials rush after like a torrent or an avalanche. A small misstep cannot be reversed by a word or a single effort—those above must tread with care.

sentences.zh: 今聖意已有所向而為天下先矣。

translations.literal: Now the sage's intent already has a direction and has put itself ahead of all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Yet now the throne has already chosen a course and placed itself ahead of the realm.

sentences.zh: 乞諭執政：'前日降出文字，卻且進入。

translations.literal: I beg that the chief councilors be instructed: 'The documents issued the other day should for the moment be submitted again.'
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the chief councilors be told: "The documents issued the other day should for now be held back and not yet forwarded."

sentences.zh: '免希合之臣，妄測聖意，輕舉大役。」

translations.literal: Lest ministers who curry favor presumptuously divine the sage's intent and rashly undertake a great project.'
translations.idiomatic: Lest sycophantic ministers presume to read the throne's mind and rashly launch a vast public works campaign."

sentences.zh: 尚書王存等亦言：「使大河決可東回，而北流遂斷，何惜勞民費財，以成經久之利。

translations.literal: Minister of the Secretariat Wang Cun and others also said: 'If the great river can assuredly be turned back east and the northern flow cut off, why spare laboring the people and spending treasure to secure a lasting benefit?
translations.idiomatic: Minister Wang Cun and others also argued: "If the great river can truly be turned back east and the northern channel shut off, why hesitate to spend treasure and burden the people to secure a lasting gain?

sentences.zh: 今孝先等自未有必然之論，但僥倖萬一，以冀成功，又預求免責，若遂聽之，將有噬臍之悔。

translations.literal: Now Xiaoxian and others themselves have no argument of certainty, but gamble on one chance in ten thousand hoping for success, and moreover seek exemption from blame in advance; if we heed them, there will be the regret of biting one's navel.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiaoxian and his allies offer no proof that success is certain—only a one-in-ten-thousand gamble—and they have already sought immunity from blame. If the court follows them, it will rue the day too late to undo the harm.

sentences.zh: 乞望選公正近臣及忠實內侍，覆行按視，審度可否，興工未晚。」

translations.literal: I beg that fair-minded close ministers and loyal inner attendants be chosen to conduct a follow-up inspection, assess whether it is feasible, and then start work—it would not be too late.'
translations.idiomatic: We beg that upright ministers close to the throne and trustworthy inner attendants be chosen to reinspect on the ground, judge whether the project can succeed, and only then begin work—it would not be too late."

sentences.zh: 庚子，三省、樞密院奏事延和殿，文彥博、呂大防、安燾等謂：「河不東，則失中國之險，為契丹之利。」

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs reported affairs at Yanhe Hall; Wen Yanbo, Lü Dafang, An Che, and others said: 'If the river does not flow east, China loses its strategic barrier—to the Khitan's advantage.'
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs presented business in Yanhe Hall. Wen Yanbo, Lü Dafang, An Che, and others argued: "If the river does not run east again, the empire loses its strategic barrier—and the Khitan gain."

sentences.zh: 范純仁、王存、胡宗愈則以虛費勞民為憂。

translations.literal: Fan Chunren, Wang Cun, and Hu Zongyu, by contrast, worried about empty expenditure and burdening the people.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Chunren, Wang Cun, and Hu Zongyu, by contrast, worried chiefly about wasted funds and exhausted commoners.

sentences.zh: 存謂：「今公私財力困匱，惟朝廷未甚知者，賴先帝時封樁錢物可用耳。

translations.literal: Cun said: 'Public and private financial strength are now exhausted; what the court does not yet fully know is that we rely only on the sealed reserve funds from the late emperor's reign being still usable.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Cun said: "Public and private resources are now spent to the bone. What the court may not yet fully grasp is that we are living on the sealed reserves the late emperor left—nothing more.

sentences.zh: 外路往往空乏，奈何起數千萬物料、兵夫，圖不可必成之功？

translations.literal: The outer circuits are often empty and depleted—how can we raise tens of millions in materials and laborers for a project that may not necessarily succeed?
translations.idiomatic: The outer circuits are often bare. How can we mobilize tens of millions' worth of materials and laborers for a project that may never succeed?

sentences.zh: 且禦契丹得其道，則自景德至今八九十年，通好如一家，設險何與焉？

translations.literal: Moreover, if we handle the Khitan by the right method, from Jingde until now for eight or nine decades we have been on friendly terms like one family—what need is there for artificial barriers?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, if we manage the Khitan wisely, we have lived in peace like one household from the Jingde era until now—eighty or ninety years. What need is there for engineered barriers?

sentences.zh: 不然，如石晉末耶律德光犯闕，豈無黃河為阻，況今河流未必便沖過北界耶？」

translations.literal: If not, as at the end of Later Jin when Yelü Deguang invaded the capital—was there not the Yellow River as a barrier? Besides, today's river course may not readily break through the northern border.'
translations.idiomatic: If not, consider the end of Later Jin, when Yelü Deguang marched on the capital—did the Yellow River not still stand in his way? Besides, today's current may not readily punch through the northern frontier."

sentences.zh: 太后曰：「且熟議。」

translations.literal: The empress dowager said: 'Deliberate thoroughly first.'
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager said: "Deliberate further before deciding."

sentences.zh: 明日，純仁又畫四不可之說，且曰：「北流數年未為大患，而議者恐失中國之利，先事回改；

translations.literal: The next day, Chunren again presented a memorial setting forth four grounds why it should not be done, and said: 'The northern flow for several years has not been a great calamity, yet advocates fear losing China's advantage and would alter course preemptively;
translations.idiomatic: The next day Fan Chunren submitted a memorial outlining four reasons the project should not proceed. He said: "The northern channel has not been a major disaster these past several years, yet advocates, fearing the empire will lose a strategic advantage, would alter the river preemptively—

sentences.zh: 正如頃西夏本不為邊患，而好事者以為不取恐失機會，遂興靈武之師也。

translations.literal: just as recently Xixia was not in itself a frontier threat, yet busybodies thought that not seizing it meant missing an opportunity, and thus the Lingwu campaign was launched.
translations.idiomatic: just as recently, when Xixia was no real frontier threat, eager officials insisted that failure to strike meant missing our chance—and so the Lingwu campaign was launched.

sentences.zh: 臣聞孔子論為政曰：'先有司。

translations.literal: Your subject has heard Confucius on governing the state say: 'First, [establish] the officers.'
translations.idiomatic: I have heard Confucius on government say: "First put the right officers in place."

sentences.zh: '今水官未嘗保明，而先示決欲回河之旨，他日敗事，是使之得以藉口也。」

translations.literal: Now the water officials have never guaranteed success, yet we already show a resolved intent to turn the river back; when it fails later, that gives them grounds to excuse themselves.'
translations.idiomatic: The hydraulic officers have never guaranteed success, yet the court has already signaled a fixed intent to turn the river back. When the work fails later, they will have their excuse ready."

sentences.zh: 存、宗愈亦奏：「昨親聞德音，更令熟議。

translations.literal: Cun and Zongyu also memorialized: 'Yesterday we personally heard your gracious command to deliberate further.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Cun and Hu Zongyu also memorialized: "Yesterday we personally heard Your Majesty's gracious command to deliberate further.

sentences.zh: 然累日猶有未同，或令建議者結罪任責。

translations.literal: Yet for days opinion remains divided; some propose making the advocates pledge guilt and bear responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Yet after many days opinions still differ. Some propose making the advocates pledge guilt and bear sole responsibility.

sentences.zh: 臣等本謂建議之人，思慮有所未逮，故乞差官覆按。

translations.literal: We originally held that those who proposed it had not thought matters through, and therefore begged that officials be sent to reinspect.
translations.idiomatic: We originally believed the proponents had not thought the matter through, and therefore begged that officials be sent to reinspect on site.

sentences.zh: 若但使之結罪，彼所見不過如此，後或誤事，加罪何益。

translations.literal: If we only make them pledge guilt, their view extends no further than this; if they err later, of what use is added punishment?
translations.idiomatic: If we only make them pledge guilt, their judgment will go no deeper than it already does. If they err later, added punishment will do no good.

sentences.zh: 臣非不知河決北流，為患非一。

translations.literal: Your subjects are not unaware that when the river broke and flowed north, the harms were many.
translations.idiomatic: We are not unaware that when the river broke northward it brought many harms.

sentences.zh: 淤沿邊塘泊，斷御河漕運，失中國之險，遏西山之流。

translations.literal: It silted up frontier ponds and weirs along the border, cut off Imperial Canal grain transport, lost China's strategic barrier, and blocked streams from the western hills.
translations.idiomatic: It silted frontier pond-weirs, severed grain transport on the Imperial Canal, cost the empire its strategic barrier, and blocked streams from the western hills.

sentences.zh: 若能全回大河，使由孫村故道，豈非上下通願？

translations.literal: If the great river could fully return via Sun Village's old course, would that not be the shared wish of court and country?
translations.idiomatic: If the great river could fully return through Sun Village's old channel, would that not be the wish of throne and realm alike?

sentences.zh: 但恐不能成功，為患甚於今日。

translations.literal: But we fear it cannot succeed, and the harm would exceed today's.
translations.idiomatic: But we fear it cannot succeed—and the harm would exceed what we suffer today.

sentences.zh: 故欲選近臣按視：若孝先之說決可成，則積聚物料，接續興役；

translations.literal: Therefore we wish close ministers selected to inspect on site: if Wang Xiaoxian's plan can definitely succeed, then stock materials and proceed with the work;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we wish close ministers chosen to inspect on site: if Wang Xiaoxian's plan can truly succeed, then stock materials and proceed with the work;

sentences.zh: 如不可為，則令沿河踏行，自恩、魏以北，塘泊以南，別求可以疏導歸海去處，不必專主孫村。

translations.literal: if it cannot be done, then have them walk the riverbank—from En and Wei northward, south of the pond-weirs—and find elsewhere to channel and send to the sea, not insisting solely on Sun Village.
translations.idiomatic: if it cannot be done, then have them walk the banks from En and Wei northward and south of the pond-weirs to find another route to channel the water to the sea, without insisting solely on Sun Village.

sentences.zh: 此亦三省共曾商量，望賜詳酌。」

translations.literal: This the Three Departments have jointly discussed; we beg thorough consideration.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments have jointly discussed this as well. We beg Your Majesty's thorough deliberation."

sentences.zh: 存又奏：「自古惟有導河並塞河。

translations.literal: Cun further memorialized: 'Since antiquity there has only been guiding the river and blocking the river.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Cun further memorialized: "Since antiquity there have been only two ways to manage a river: guiding it and blocking it.

sentences.zh: 導河者順水勢，自高導令就下；

translations.literal: Guiding the river follows the water's tendency, leading from high to low;
translations.idiomatic: To guide a river is to follow its tendency, leading it from high ground down to low;

sentences.zh: 塞河者為河堤決溢，修塞令入河身。

translations.literal: blocking the river is when dikes breach and overflow, repairing the breach to return flow to the river channel.
translations.idiomatic: to block a river is to repair a breached dike and return the water to the main channel.

sentences.zh: 不聞幹引大河令就高行流也。」

translations.literal: I have never heard of forcibly drawing the great river to flow uphill.'
translations.idiomatic: I have never heard of forcibly drawing the great river to run uphill."

sentences.zh: 於是收回戊戌詔書。

translations.literal: Thereupon the wuxu edict was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the wuxu edict was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎蘇轍、中書舍人曾肇各三上疏。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Su Zhe and Secretariat Drafter Zeng Zhao each submitted three memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Revenue Su Zhe and Secretariat Drafter Zeng Zhao each submitted three memorials.

sentences.zh: 轍大略言：

translations.literal: Su Zhe's gist was:
translations.idiomatic: Su Zhe's memorial, in outline, stated:

sentences.zh: 黃河西流，議復故道。

translations.literal: The Yellow River flows west; they debate restoring the old course.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River flows west, and officials debate restoring its old course.

sentences.zh: 事之經歲，役兵二萬，聚梢樁等物三十余萬。

translations.literal: The project has run a year, employing twenty thousand soldiers, gathering over three hundred thousand timbers, stakes, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The work has already run a year, employing twenty thousand troops and gathering more than three hundred thousand timbers, stakes, and similar materials.

sentences.zh: 方河朔災傷困弊，而興必不可成之功，吏民竊歎。

translations.literal: Just as the north of the river suffers disaster and exhaustion, they undertake work that cannot possibly succeed; officials and people sigh in private.
translations.idiomatic: Just as the north of the river lies ruined by disaster and want, the state undertakes a project that cannot possibly succeed—and officials and commoners sigh in private.

sentences.zh: 今回河大議雖寢，然聞議者固執來歲開河分水之策。

translations.literal: Now the great debate on turning the river back has been laid to rest, yet I hear advocates still cling to next year's plan to open channels and divide the water.
translations.idiomatic: The great debate on turning the river back has been set aside, yet I hear that advocates still cling to next year's plan to open channels and split the flow.

sentences.zh: 今小吳決口，入地已深，而孫村所開，丈尺有限，不獨不能回河，亦必不能分水。

translations.literal: Today's Xiao Wu breach has cut deep into the ground, while what is opened at Sun Village is limited in size—not only can it not turn the river back, it certainly cannot divide the flow.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiao Wu breach has already cut deep into the ground, while the opening at Sun Village is limited in size. It cannot turn the river back—and it certainly cannot divide the water.

sentences.zh: 況黃河之性，急則通流，緩則淤澱，既無東西皆急之勢，安有兩河並行之理？

translations.literal: Moreover the Yellow River's nature is: when swift it runs clear, when slow it silts—without both east and west being swift, how could two rivers run in parallel?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the Yellow River runs clear when swift and silts when slow. Without swift currents on both east and west courses, how could two channels run side by side?

sentences.zh: 縱使兩河並行，未免各立堤防，其費又倍矣。

translations.literal: Even if two rivers ran in parallel, each would need its own dikes—the cost would double again.
translations.idiomatic: Even if two channels could run in parallel, each would still need its own dikes—and the cost would double again.

sentences.zh: 今建議者其說有三，臣請折之：一曰御河湮滅，失饋運之利。

translations.literal: The advocates' arguments are three; your subject begs to refute them: First, that the Imperial Canal is buried and transport profit is lost.
translations.idiomatic: The advocates advance three arguments, which I beg to refute. First: the Imperial Canal has been buried and we have lost the benefit of transport.

sentences.zh: 昔大河在東，御河自懷、衛經北京，漸曆邊郡，饋運既便，商賈通行。

translations.literal: Formerly when the great river was east, the Imperial Canal ran from Huai and Wei through Beijing, gradually along frontier prefectures—transport was convenient and merchants traveled freely.
translations.idiomatic: When the great river ran east, the Imperial Canal ran from Huai and Wei through Beijing and on along the frontier circuits. Transport was easy and merchants moved freely.

sentences.zh: 自河西流，御河湮滅，失此大利，天實使然。

translations.literal: Since the river turned west the canal was buried and this great benefit lost—Heaven in truth made it so.
translations.idiomatic: Since the river turned west the canal has been buried and this great benefit lost—Heaven itself ordained it.

sentences.zh: 今河自小吳北行，占壓御河故地，雖使自北京以南折而東行，則御河湮滅已一二百里，何由復見？

translations.literal: Now the river runs north from Xiao Wu, occupying the old canal ground; even if from south of Beijing it bent east, the canal has been buried for one or two hundred li—how could it be restored?
translations.idiomatic: Today the river runs north from Xiao Wu, covering the old canal bed. Even if it were bent east again south of Beijing, the canal has lain buried for one or two hundred li. How could it be restored?

sentences.zh: 此御河之說不足聽也。

translations.literal: This argument about the Imperial Canal is not worth hearing.
translations.idiomatic: This argument about the Imperial Canal is not worth heeding.

sentences.zh: 二曰恩、冀以北，漲水為害，公私損耗。

translations.literal: Second, that north of En and Ji, floodwaters harm and public and private interests suffer loss.
translations.idiomatic: Second: that north of En and Ji, rising floodwaters harm the region and drain both public and private resources.

sentences.zh: 臣聞河之所行，利害相半，蓋水來雖有敗田破稅之害，其去亦有淤厚宿麥之利。

translations.literal: Your subject hears that where the river runs, benefit and harm are half and half—for though incoming water has the harm of ruining fields and breaking tax yields, when it retreats there is also the benefit of depositing silt that enriches winter wheat.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that wherever the river runs, benefit and harm balance each other. Incoming water may ruin fields and tax yields, but when it retreats it deposits silt that enriches the winter wheat.

sentences.zh: 況故道已退之地，桑麻千里，賦役全復，此漲水之說不足聽也。

translations.literal: Moreover where the old course has receded, mulberry and hemp span a thousand li, levies fully restored—this flood argument is not worth hearing.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, where the old channel has receded, mulberry and hemp fields stretch for a thousand li and levies have fully returned. This argument about flood damage is not worth heeding.

sentences.zh: 三曰河徙無常，萬一自契丹界入海，邊防失備。

translations.literal: Third, that the river's course shifts without constancy—if by chance it entered the sea through Khitan territory, frontier defense would lose its preparedness.
translations.idiomatic: Third: that the river's course is uncertain, and that if by chance it reached the sea through Khitan territory, frontier defenses would fail.

sentences.zh: 按河昔在東，自河以西郡縣，與契丹接境，無山河之限，邊臣建為塘水，以捍契丹之沖。

translations.literal: When the river was formerly east, the prefectures west of the river bordered the Khitan with no mountain-river barrier; border officials built pond weirs to block Khitan thrusts.
translations.idiomatic: When the river ran east, the prefectures west of it bordered the Khitan with no mountain or river barrier. Border officials therefore built pond-weirs to block Khitan raids.

sentences.zh: 今河既西，則西山一帶，契丹可行之地無幾，邊防之利，不言可知。

translations.literal: Now the river is west—the western hills leave the Khitan little passable ground; the frontier advantage needs no words to be known.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the river lies west, the western hills leave the Khitan little ground to cross. The frontier advantage needs no elaboration.

sentences.zh: 然議者尚恐河復北徙，則海口出契丹界中，造舟為梁，便於南牧。

translations.literal: Yet advocates still fear the river might shift north again, so the estuary would lie within Khitan territory—they could build boats and bridges, convenient for southern pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Yet advocates still fear the river may shift north again, so that its mouth would lie in Khitan lands. They could then build boats and bridges and raid south with ease.

sentences.zh: 臣聞契丹之河，自北南注以入於海。

translations.literal: Your subject hears that the Khitan's rivers flow from the north southward into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that the Khitan's own rivers flow from north to south into the sea.

sentences.zh: 蓋地形北高，河無北徙之道，而海口深浚，勢無徙移，此邊防之說不足聽也。

translations.literal: The terrain is higher in the north—rivers have no path to shift north, and the estuary is deep-dredged with no tendency to shift; this frontier argument is not worth hearing.
translations.idiomatic: The land is higher in the north, so rivers have no path to shift northward, and the estuary is deep and unlikely to move. This frontier argument, too, is not worth heeding.

sentences.zh: 臣又聞謝卿材到闕，昌言：「黃河自小吳決口，乘高注北，水勢奔決，上流堤防無復決怒之患。

translations.literal: Your subject also hears that Xie Qingcai reached court and proclaimed loudly: 'Since the Yellow River broke at Xiao Wu, pouring north from high ground, the water's force rushes in torrent—the upper dikes no longer face the peril of bursting wrath.
translations.idiomatic: I also hear that when Xie Qingcai reached court he proclaimed: "Since the Yellow River broke at Xiao Wu and poured north from high ground, the current rushes away with force. The upper dikes no longer face the danger of bursting.

sentences.zh: 朝廷若以河事付臣，不役一夫，不費一金，十年保無河患。」

translations.literal: If the court entrusted river affairs to your subject, employing no laborer, spending no coin, I guarantee no river trouble for ten years.'
translations.idiomatic: If the court entrusted river affairs to me, I would employ no laborer, spend no coin, and guarantee no river trouble for ten years."

sentences.zh: 大臣以其異已罷歸，而使王孝先、俞瑾、張景先三人重畫回河之計。

translations.literal: Senior ministers dismissed him for dissenting from their view and sent him home, then had Wang Xiaoxian, Yu Jin, and Zhang Jingxian redraw the plan to turn the river back.
translations.idiomatic: The senior ministers dismissed him for disagreeing with them and sent him home, then had Wang Xiaoxian, Yu Jin, and Zhang Jingxian redraw the plan to turn the river back.

sentences.zh: 蓋由元老大臣重于改過，故假契丹不測之憂，以取必於朝廷。

translations.literal: This was because senior ministers were loath to admit error, and so cited unpredictable Khitan fears to compel the court.
translations.idiomatic: This arose because the senior ministers were reluctant to admit a mistake and therefore invoked unpredictable Khitan dangers to force the court's hand.

sentences.zh: 雖已遣百祿等出按利害，然未敢保其不觀望風旨也。

translations.literal: Though Bailu and others were already sent to survey harm and benefit on site, I dare not guarantee they will not watch for the prevailing wind of intent.
translations.idiomatic: Although Fan Bailu and others have been sent to survey the project's costs and benefits, I dare not guarantee they will not watch for the prevailing court sentiment.

sentences.zh: 願亟回收買梢草指揮，來歲勿調開河役兵，使百祿等明知聖意無所偏系，不至阿附以誤國計。

translations.literal: I beg urgently to withdraw the order to purchase timbers and rushes, not to mobilize river workers next year, so that Bailu and others clearly know the sage mind is unbiased and will not flatter to ruin state plans.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the order to purchase timbers and rushes be withdrawn at once and that river labor not be mobilized next year, so that Bailu and his colleagues know clearly that the throne's mind is unbiased and will not flatter their superiors to the ruin of the state.

sentences.zh: 肇之言曰：「數年以來，河北、京東、淮南災傷，今歲河北並邊稍熟，而近南州軍皆旱，京東、西、淮南饑殍瘡痍。

translations.literal: Zeng Zhao's words said: 'For years Hebei, Jingdong, and Huainan have suffered disaster; this year Hebei and the border areas are somewhat fertile, yet the southern circuits near the capital are all drought-stricken, and Jingdong, Jingxi, and Huainan show famine corpses and wounds.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Zhao wrote: "For years Hebei, Jingdong, and Huainan have suffered disasters. This year Hebei and the border districts are somewhat fertile, but the southern circuits are drought-stricken, and Jingdong, Jingxi, and Huainan are scarred by famine and corpses in the fields.

sentences.zh: 若來年雖未大興河役，止令修治舊堤，開減水河，亦須調發丁夫。

translations.literal: If next year even without a major river project, only repairing old dikes and opening flood-relief channels, corvée labor must still be mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: Even if next year brings no major river works—only repairs to old dikes and opening flood-relief channels—corvée labor must still be mobilized.

sentences.zh: 本路不足，則及鄰路，鄰路不足，則及淮南，民力果何以堪？

translations.literal: If this circuit lacks labor, then neighboring circuits are tapped; if neighbors lack, then Huainan—how can the people's strength bear it?
translations.idiomatic: If one circuit lacks labor, the next is tapped; if neighbors lack labor, Huainan is drawn on. How can the people's strength bear it?

sentences.zh: 民力未堪，則雖有回河之策，及梢草先具，將安施乎？」

translations.literal: If the people's strength cannot bear it, then though the plan to turn the river back exists and timbers and rushes are already prepared—how could it be applied?'
translations.idiomatic: If the people cannot bear the burden, then even if the plan to turn the river back stands ready and timbers and rushes are stockpiled—how could it be carried out?"

sentences.zh: 會百祿等行視東西二河，亦以為東流高仰，北流順下，決不可回。

translations.literal: When Bailu and others went to inspect the east and west flows on site, they too judged the east flow high and steep, the north flow smooth downhill—decidedly impossible to turn back.
translations.idiomatic: When Fan Bailu and his colleagues inspected the eastern and northern channels on site, they too concluded that the eastern course ran high and steep while the northern flow ran easily downhill—and that the river could certainly not be turned back.

sentences.zh: 即奏曰：

translations.literal: They immediately memorialized, saying:
translations.idiomatic: They immediately memorialized:

sentences.zh: 往者王令圖、張問欲開引水簽河，導水入孫村口還復故道。

translations.literal: Formerly Wang Lingtu and Zhang Wen wished to open the diversion sluice canal, guiding water into Sun Village mouth to restore the old course.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Wang Lingtu and Zhang Wen proposed opening a diversion sluice canal to guide water into Sun Village and restore the old channel.

sentences.zh: 議者疑焉，故置官設屬，使之講議。

translations.literal: Skeptics doubted, so offices and staff were established for them to discuss and debate.
translations.idiomatic: Skeptics raised doubts, so offices and staff were established for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 既開撅井筒，折量地形水面尺寸高下，顧臨、王孝先、張景先、唐義問、陳祐之皆謂故道難復。

translations.literal: After opening probe wells and measuring terrain and water surface dimensions and elevations, Gu Lin, Wang Xiaoxian, Zhang Jingxian, Tang Yiwen, and Chen Youzhi all said the old course was hard to restore.
translations.idiomatic: After probe wells were opened and terrain and water levels measured, Gu Lin, Wang Xiaoxian, Zhang Jingxian, Tang Yiwen, and Chen Youzhi all judged the old channel difficult to restore.

sentences.zh: 而孝先獨叛其說，初乞先開減水河，俟行流通快，新河勢緩，人工物料豐備，徐議閉塞北流。

translations.literal: But Xiaoxian alone broke from their view, first asking to open a flood-relief canal first, wait until the flow ran swift, the new river current slowed, labor and materials were ample, then slowly discuss blocking the north flow.
translations.idiomatic: But Wang Xiaoxian alone broke ranks. He first asked to open a flood-relief canal, wait until the flow ran swift and the new channel slowed, and labor and materials were ample—then discuss blocking the northern flow.

sentences.zh: 已而召赴都堂，則又請以二年為期。

translations.literal: Then when summoned to the Secretariat Hall, he again asked for a two-year term.
translations.idiomatic: When he was summoned to the Secretariat Hall, he then asked for a two-year deadline.

sentences.zh: 及朝廷詰其成功，遽云：「來年取水入孫村口，若河流順快，工料有備，便可閉塞，回復故道。」

translations.literal: When the court pressed him on success, he suddenly said: 'Next year draw water into Sun Village mouth; if the river flow is smooth and swift and materials are ready, we can block and restore the old course.'
translations.idiomatic: When the court pressed him on how he would succeed, he suddenly said: "Next year we will draw water into Sun Village. If the flow runs smooth and materials are ready, we can block the channel and restore the old course."

sentences.zh: 是又不俟新河勢緩矣。

translations.literal: Thus he no longer waited for the new river current to slow.
translations.idiomatic: Thus he no longer waited for the new channel to slow.

sentences.zh: 回河事大，甯容異同如此！

translations.literal: Turning the river back is a great matter—how can such inconsistency be allowed!
translations.idiomatic: Turning the river back is a matter of great weight—how can such inconsistency be tolerated!

sentences.zh: 蓋孝先、俞瑾等知合用物料五千余萬，未有指擬，見買數計，經歲未及毫釐，度事理終不可為，故為大言。

translations.literal: Xiaoxian, Jin, and others knew needed materials exceeded fifty million with no allocation designated; purchases on the books over a year scarcely reached a fraction—they judged the matter ultimately impossible and therefore spoke grandly.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiaoxian, Yu Jin, and their allies knew the project required more than fifty million units of materials with no funds allocated. Purchases over a year had scarcely begun. Judging the work impossible, they spoke in grand promises.

sentences.zh: 又云：「若失此時，或河勢移背，豈獨不可減水，即永無回河之理。」

translations.literal: They also said: 'If this moment is missed, or the river's force shifts away, not only would flood relief be impossible—even turning the river back would forever be impossible.'
translations.idiomatic: They also said: "Miss this moment, or the river shifts away, and not only flood relief becomes impossible—even turning the river back would be lost forever."

sentences.zh: 臣等竊謂河流轉徙，乃其常事；

translations.literal: We privately hold that a river's shifting course is its constant way;
translations.idiomatic: We hold privately that a river's shifting course is its natural way;

sentences.zh: 水性就下，固無一定。

translations.literal: water by nature seeks low ground and is never fixed.
translations.idiomatic: and water by nature seeks low ground and is never fixed.

sentences.zh: 若假以五年，休養數路民力，沿河積材，漸浚故道，葺舊堤，一旦流勢改變，審議事理，釃為二渠，分派行流，均減漲水之害，則勞費不大，功力易施，安得謂之一失此時，永無回河之理也？

translations.literal: If given five years to rest the people's strength on several circuits, stock materials along the river, gradually dredge the old course and repair old dikes—once the current's force changed, deliberate on the matter, split into two channels to divide the flow and evenly reduce flood harm—then labor and cost would not be great and the work easy to apply. How can one say that missing this one moment means forever no grounds to turn the river back?
translations.idiomatic: If given five years to rest the people on several circuits, stock materials along the river, gradually dredge the old channel and repair the old dikes, then—once the current changed—deliberate and split the flow into two channels to ease flood damage, the labor and cost would be modest and the work manageable. How can one say that missing this moment means the river can never be turned back?

sentences.zh: 四年正月癸末，百祿等使回入對，復言：「修減水河，役過兵夫六萬三千余人，計五百三十萬工，費錢糧三十九萬二千九百余貫、石、匹、兩，收買物料錢七十五萬三百餘緡，用過物料二百九十余萬條、束，官員、使臣、軍大將凡一百一十餘員請給不預焉。

translations.literal: In the first month on guiwei of the fourth year, Bailu's mission returned and reported in audience, again saying: 'Repairing the flood-relief canal employed more than sixty-three thousand soldiers, totaling five million three hundred thousand work-days, costing 392,900-plus in cash, grain, bolts, and taels; material purchases 750,300-plus strings; materials used more than 2.9 million pieces and bundles—the salaries of more than 110 officials, envoys, and military officers not included.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the first month in the fourth year, Fan Bailu's mission returned and reported to the throne: "Repairing the flood-relief canal employed more than sixty-three thousand laborers, totaling 5.3 million work-days. It cost 392,900-plus units of cash, grain, bolts, and taels; material purchases totaled 750,300-plus strings; and more than 2.9 million bundles of materials were used—the salaries of more than 110 officials, envoys, and military officers not included.

sentences.zh: 願罷有害無利之役，那移工料，繕築西堤，以護南決口。」

translations.literal: We beg to end work harmful without benefit, shift labor and materials, and repair the west dike to protect the southern breach.'
translations.idiomatic: We beg to end this harmful and unprofitable work, shift labor and materials, and repair the western dike to protect the southern breach."

sentences.zh: 未報。

translations.literal: No reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: No reply was issued.

sentences.zh: 己亥，乃詔罷回河及修減水河。

translations.literal: On jihai an edict ended turning the river back and repairing the flood-relief canal.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day an edict halted the project to turn the river back and the repair of the flood-relief canal.

sentences.zh: 四月戊午，尚書省言：「大河東流，為中國之要險。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on wuwu, the Ministry of Revenue said: 'The great river flowing east is China's vital strategic barrier.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the fourth month, the Ministry of Revenue reported: "The great river flowing east is the empire's vital strategic barrier.

sentences.zh: 自大吳決後，由界河入海，不惟淤壞塘濼，兼濁水入界河，向去淺澱，則河必北流。

translations.literal: Since the Da Wu breach, entering the sea via the Border River—not only silting and ruining pond-weirs, but also muddy water entering the Border River—if silting continues ahead, the river will necessarily flow north.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Da Wu breach it has entered the sea through the Border River. This has not only silted and ruined the pond-weirs but also sent muddy water into the Border River. If silting continues, the river will inevitably turn north again.

sentences.zh: 若河尾直注北界入海，則中國全失險阻之限，不可不為深慮。」

translations.literal: If the river's mouth entered the sea directly through the northern border, China would wholly lose its strategic barrier—this must be deeply considered.'
translations.idiomatic: If the river's mouth were to enter the sea directly through the northern frontier, the empire would wholly lose its strategic barrier. This demands the deepest consideration."

sentences.zh: 詔范百祿、趙君錫條畫以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Fan Bailu and Zhao Junxi to draft plans and report.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered Fan Bailu and Zhao Junxi to draft plans and report.

sentences.zh: 百祿等言：

translations.literal: Bailu and others stated:
translations.idiomatic: Fan Bailu and his colleagues reported:

sentences.zh: 臣等昨按行黃河獨流口至界河，又東至海口，熟觀河流形勢；

translations.literal: We yesterday surveyed from the Yellow River's sole outlet to the Border River, then east to the estuary, closely observing the river's force and configuration;
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday we surveyed from the Yellow River's sole outlet to the Border River and on east to the estuary, closely observing the current's configuration;

sentences.zh: 並緣界河至海口鋪砦地分使臣各稱：界河未經黃河行流已前，闊一百五十步下至五十步，深一丈五尺下至一丈；

translations.literal: and along the Border River to the estuary posts, envoys in each sector reported: before the Yellow River flowed through the Border River, it was 150 bu wide down to 50 bu, 1 zhang 5 chi deep down to 1 zhang;
translations.idiomatic: and along the Border River to the estuary posts, envoys in each sector reported that before the Yellow River flowed through it, the channel was 150 bu wide at most and 50 bu at least, and 1.5 zhang deep at most and 1 zhang at least;

sentences.zh: 自黃河行流之後，今闊至五百四十步，次亦三二百步，深者三丈五尺，次亦二丈。

translations.literal: after the Yellow River flowed through, it is now as wide as 540 bu, next also 200-300 bu; the deepest 3 zhang 5 chi, next also 2 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: but after the Yellow River flowed through it, the channel is now as wide as 540 bu in places and 200 to 300 bu elsewhere, and as deep as 3.5 zhang in places and 2 zhang elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 乃知水性就下，行疾則自刮除成空而稍深，與《前漢書》大司馬史張戎之論正合。

translations.literal: Thus we know water by nature seeks low ground—when swift it scours itself hollow and grows somewhat deeper—matching exactly the discourse of Zhang Rong, Grand Marshal's clerk, in the Former Han Book.
translations.idiomatic: Thus we know that water seeks low ground and that a swift current scours its bed deeper—exactly matching Zhang Rong's argument in the Book of Former Han.

sentences.zh: 自元豐四年河出大吳，一向就下，沖入界河，行流勢如傾建。

translations.literal: Since Yuanfeng year 4 when the river issued from Da Wu, all the way downhill into the Border River, the flowing current's force was like pouring from a tilted building.
translations.idiomatic: Since the fourth year of Yuanfeng, when the river broke out at Da Wu, it has run steadily downhill into the Border River, its current pouring like water from a tilted roof.

sentences.zh: 經今八年，不舍晝夜，沖刷界河，兩岸日漸開闊，連底成空，趨海之勢甚迅。

translations.literal: Eight years now without ceasing day or night, scouring the Border River—the banks daily widening, the bottom hollowed through, the rush to the sea very swift.
translations.idiomatic: For eight years now, without ceasing day or night, it has scoured the Border River. The banks widen daily, the bottom is hollowed out, and the rush to the sea is very swift.

sentences.zh: 雖遇元豐七年八年、元祐元年泛漲非常，而大吳以上數百里，終無決溢之害，此乃下流歸納處河流深快之驗也。

translations.literal: Though Yuanfeng years 7 and 8 and Yuanyou year 1 saw extraordinary flooding, for several hundred li above Da Wu there was ultimately no breach or overflow harm—this is proof that where the lower reach receives the flow, the river is deep and swift.
translations.idiomatic: Although the extraordinary floods of Yuanfeng years seven and eight and Yuanyou year one occurred, for several hundred li above Da Wu there were ultimately no breaches or overflows—proof that where the lower reach receives the flow, the river runs deep and fast.

sentences.zh: 塘濼有限遼之名，無禦遼之實。

translations.literal: The pond-weirs have the name of blocking the Liao but not the reality of blocking the Liao.
translations.idiomatic: The pond-weirs bear the name of blocking the Liao but not the reality.

sentences.zh: 今之塘水，又異昔時，淺足以褰裳而涉，深足以維舟而濟，冬寒冰堅，尤為坦途。

translations.literal: Today's pond water again differs from former times—shallow enough to hike up one's skirts and wade across, deep enough to moor boats and cross; in winter the ice is hard and especially a level road.
translations.idiomatic: Today's pond water differs again from former times. Where it is shallow, one can hike up one's skirts and wade across; where it is deep, boats can moor and cross. In winter the ice is firm and especially offers a level road.

sentences.zh: 如滄州等處，商胡之決即已澱淤，今四十二年，迄無邊警，亦無人言以為深憂。

translations.literal: At places such as Cangzhou, the Shanghu breach has already silted up; now forty-two years with no frontier alarm, and no one speaks of it as a deep worry.
translations.idiomatic: At places such as Cangzhou, the Shanghu breach has long since silted up. Forty-two years have passed with no frontier alarm, and no one speaks of it as a grave concern.

sentences.zh: 自回河之議起，首以此動煩聖聽。

translations.literal: Since the debate on turning the river back arose, this was first used to trouble the sage ear.
translations.idiomatic: Only since the debate on turning the river back arose has this been raised to trouble the throne's attention.

sentences.zh: 殊不思大吳初決，水未有歸，猶不北去；

translations.literal: They never consider that when Da Wu first breached, the water had nowhere to go and still did not turn north;
translations.idiomatic: They never reflect that when Da Wu first breached and the water had nowhere to go, the river still did not turn north.

sentences.zh: 今入海湍迅，界河益深，尚復何慮？

translations.literal: Now entering the sea with swift turbulent flow, the Border River grows ever deeper—what is there still to worry about?
translations.idiomatic: Now the river enters the sea in a swift torrent and the Border River grows ever deeper—what remains to fear?

sentences.zh: 藉令有此，則中國據上游，契丹豈不慮乘流擾之乎？

translations.literal: Suppose this were so—China holds the upper reaches; would not the Khitan fear riding the current to harass us?
translations.idiomatic: Even if it were so, the empire holds the upper reaches—would the Khitan not fear riding the current downstream to harass us?

sentences.zh: 自古朝那、蕭關、雲中、朔方、定襄、雁門、上郡、太原、右北平之間，南北往來之沖，豈塘濼界河之足限哉。

translations.literal: Since antiquity between Chaona, Xiaoguan, Yunzhong, Shuofang, Dingxiang, Yanmen, Shangjun, Taiyuan, and Youbeiping—the thoroughfares of north-south passage—how could pond-weirs and the Border River alone suffice to constrain them.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity the routes between Chaona, Xiaoguan, Yunzhong, Shuofang, Dingxiang, Yanmen, Shangjun, Taiyuan, and Youbeiping have been the great corridors of north-south traffic—pond-weirs and the Border River alone could never hold that traffic in check.

sentences.zh: 臣等竊謂本朝以來，未有大河安流，合于禹跡，如此之利便者。

translations.literal: We privately say that since our dynasty arose there has never been such convenience, with the great river peacefully flowing and matching Yu's tracks.
translations.idiomatic: We venture to say that since our dynasty arose, never has the great river flowed so peacefully in accord with Yu's course, to such advantage.

sentences.zh: 其界河向去只有深闊，加以朝夕海潮往來渲蕩，必無淺澱，河尾安得直注北界，中國亦無全失險阻之理。

translations.literal: The Border River going forward can only grow deeper and wider; add the twice-daily sea tides washing back and forth—there surely will be no shallow silt deposits; how could the river's mouth directly enter the northern border—nor is there any reason China would wholly lose its strategic barrier.
translations.idiomatic: Going forward the Border River can only grow deeper and wider. With the sea tides washing it twice daily, shallow silt deposits are impossible. How could the river's mouth pour straight into the northern frontier? Nor is there any reason the empire would wholly lose its strategic barrier.

sentences.zh: 且河遇平壤灘漫，行流稍遲，則泥沙留淤；

translations.literal: Moreover, when the river meets level plains and spreads wide, if the flow is slightly slow then mud and sand settle as silt;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when the river meets level plains and spreads wide, a slightly slower current leaves mud and sand behind as silt;

sentences.zh: 若趨深走下，湍激奔騰，惟有刮除，無由淤積，不至上煩聖慮。

translations.literal: if it rushes deep and downward, turbulent and surging, there is only scouring—no occasion for silt buildup—so it need not excessively trouble the sage concerns.
translations.idiomatic: but when it runs deep and downward in a turbulent rush, it can only scour its bed clean—silt cannot accumulate—and need not trouble the throne's attention.

sentences.zh: 七月己巳朔，冀州南宮等五埽危急，詔撥提舉修河司物料百萬與之。

translations.literal: On the first day jisi of the seventh month, the five revetments including Nangong in Jizhou were critical; an edict allocated a million in materials from the Office for River Repair to them.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, jisi, the five revetments at Nangong in Jizhou and elsewhere were in critical danger. An edict allocated a million units of material from the Office for River Repair to them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，都水監言：「河為中國患久矣，自小吳決後，氾濫未著河槽，前後遣官相度非一，終未有定論。

translations.literal: On jiawu the Directorate of Waterways said: "The river has long been China's affliction. Since the Small Wu breach, flooding has not settled into the channel; officials sent before and after to survey have been numerous, yet no settled conclusion has been reached.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day the Directorate of Waterways reported: "The river has long been the empire's scourge. Since the Small Wu breach, floods have not settled into the channel. Survey teams have been dispatched again and again, yet no final plan has been agreed upon.

sentences.zh: 以為北流無患，則前二年河決南宮下埽，去三年決上埽，今四年決宗城中埽，豈謂北流可保無虞？

translations.literal: If one holds that the northern flow is free of trouble, then two years ago the river breached the lower revetment at Nangong, three years ago the upper revetment, and this year the middle revetment at Zongcheng—can one say the northern flow can be kept free of worry?
translations.idiomatic: Those who claim the northern current is harmless should recall that two years ago the river broke the lower Nangong revetment, three years ago the upper revetment, and this year the middle Zongcheng revetment—can the northern flow truly be declared safe?

sentences.zh: 以為大河臥東，則南宮、宗城皆在西岸；

translations.literal: If one holds that the great river lies eastward, then Nangong and Zongcheng are both on the west bank;
translations.idiomatic: If one argues the great river lies to the east, then Nangong and Zongcheng are both on the west bank;

sentences.zh: 以為臥西，則冀州信都、恩州清河、武邑或決，皆在東岸。

translations.literal: if one holds it lies westward, then Xindu in Jizhou, Qinghe in Enzhou, and Wuyi may breach—all on the east bank.
translations.idiomatic: if one argues it lies to the west, then breaches at Xindu in Jizhou, Qinghe in Enzhou, or Wuyi would all strike the east bank.

sentences.zh: 要是大河千里，未見歸納經久之計，所以昨相度第三、第四鋪分決漲水，少紓目前之急。

translations.literal: In short, for a thousand li of great river no long-term plan to receive and settle the flow has been seen; therefore yesterday we surveyed dividing the flood at the third and fourth posts to ease the present crisis somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: In short, along a thousand li of great river no enduring plan to channel and settle the flow has emerged. That is why we surveyed dividing the flood at the third and fourth posts yesterday, to ease the immediate crisis somewhat.

sentences.zh: 繼又宗城決溢，向下包蓄不定，雖欲不為東流之計，不可得也。

translations.literal: Then Zongcheng again breached and overflowed; downward containment was uncertain—even if one wished not to plan for an eastern flow, it could not be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Then Zongcheng breached and overflowed again; the waters below could no longer be held in check. Even if one wished to avoid planning for an eastern flow, it was no longer possible.

sentences.zh: 河勢未可全奪，故為二股之策。

translations.literal: The river's force could not be wholly seized, so a two-channel policy was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The river's force could not be wholly diverted, so a two-channel policy was adopted.

sentences.zh: 今相視新開第一口，水勢湍猛，發洩不及，已不候工畢，更撥沙河堤第二口泄減漲水，因而二股份行，以紓下流之患。

translations.literal: Now inspecting the newly opened first mouth, the water's force was violent and swift and could not discharge fast enough; without waiting for the work to finish, a second mouth was opened through the Shahe dike to release and reduce the flood, and thus the two channels ran in parallel to ease the lower reach's affliction.
translations.idiomatic: Inspection of the newly opened first outlet showed the current too violent to discharge quickly. Without waiting for the work to finish, a second outlet was cut through the Shahe dike to bleed off the flood. The two channels now run in parallel, easing the lower reach.

sentences.zh: 雖未保冬夏常流，已見有可為之勢。

translations.literal: Though year-round flow in winter and summer is not yet guaranteed, a workable trend is already visible.
translations.idiomatic: Although year-round flow in winter and summer is not yet assured, the situation already shows what can be done.

sentences.zh: 必欲經久，遂作二股，仍較今所修利害孰為輕重，有司具析保明以聞。」

translations.literal: If one must make it lasting, then establish the two channels permanently; still compare whether what is now being repaired is lighter or heavier in harm and benefit, and let the responsible offices analyze, certify, and report."
translations.idiomatic: If a lasting solution is required, the two channels should be made permanent. Compare whether the present repairs do more harm or good, and let the responsible offices analyze, certify, and report to the throne."

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，翰林學士蘇轍言：

translations.literal: In the eighth month on dingwei, Hanlin Academician Su Zhe stated:
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the eighth month, Hanlin Academician Su Zhe memorialized:

sentences.zh: 夏秋之交，暑雨頻並。

translations.literal: At the turn of summer and autumn, heat rains came in frequent succession.
translations.idiomatic: At the turn of summer and autumn, torrential rains fell one after another.

sentences.zh: 河流暴漲出岸，由孫村東行，蓋每歲常事。

translations.literal: The river surged violently over the banks and ran east from Suncun—this is the annual routine.
translations.idiomatic: The river surged over its banks and ran east from Suncun—an event that happens every year.

sentences.zh: 而李偉與河埽使臣因此張惶，以分水為名，欲發回河之議，都水監從而和之。

translations.literal: But Li Wei and the river-revetment commissioners grew alarmed over this and, under the name of dividing the water, sought to revive the debate on turning the river back; the Directorate of Waterways chimed in.
translations.idiomatic: But Li Wei and the river-revetment commissioners panicked at this and, under the pretext of dividing the water, sought to revive the project to turn the river back—and the Directorate of Waterways echoed them.

sentences.zh: 河事一興，求無不可，況大臣以其符合己說而樂聞乎。

translations.literal: Once river works begin, nothing sought is refused—how much more when great ministers are pleased to hear what matches their own views?
translations.idiomatic: Once river works are launched, no request is denied—especially when the senior ministers are pleased to hear proposals that match their own views?

sentences.zh: 臣聞河道西行孫村側左，大約入地二丈以來，今所報漲水出岸，由新開口地東入孫村，不過六七尺。

translations.literal: I hear the river channel runs west along the left flank of Suncun, roughly two zhang or more below ground; the reported flood over the banks entering Suncun eastward through the newly opened ground is no more than six or seven chi.
translations.idiomatic: I am told the main channel runs west along the left flank of Suncun, roughly two zhang or more below the surface. The reported flood over the banks, entering Suncun eastward through the newly opened ground, is no more than six or seven chi deep.

sentences.zh: 欲因六七尺漲水，而奪入地二丈河身，雖三尺童子，知其難矣。

translations.literal: To seize a riverbed two zhang below ground with six or seven chi of flood—even a three-foot child knows how hard that is.
translations.idiomatic: To divert a channel two zhang below ground with only six or seven chi of floodwater—even a child three feet tall knows how impossible that is.

sentences.zh: 然朝廷遂為之遣都水使者，興兵功，開河道，進鋸牙，欲約之使東。

translations.literal: Yet the court has sent a waterways commissioner, raised labor troops, opened a channel, advanced saw-teeth barriers, and sought to constrain the river eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the court has dispatched a waterways commissioner, mobilized corvée labor, opened a channel, advanced saw-tooth barriers, and tried to force the river eastward.

sentences.zh: 方河水盛漲，其西行河道若不斷流，則遏之東行，實同兒戲。

translations.literal: Just as the river is in full flood, if its westward channel does not break, then blocking it to run east is truly child's play.
translations.idiomatic: With the river at full flood, if its westward channel has not dried up, forcing it eastward is mere child's play.

sentences.zh: 臣願急命有司，徐觀水勢所向，依累年漲水舊例，因其東溢，引入故道，以紓北京朝夕之憂。

translations.literal: I beg that the court urgently order the responsible offices to watch slowly where the water's force tends, follow the old precedent of years of flood overflow, and as it spills eastward lead it into the old channel to ease Beijing's day-and-night anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: I beg the court to order the responsible offices to watch patiently where the current tends, follow the precedent of past flood seasons, and as the water spills eastward guide it into the old channel to ease the Northern Capital's daily anxiety.

sentences.zh: 故道堤防壞決者，第略加修葺，免其決溢而已。

translations.literal: Where old-channel dikes are broken, only patch them slightly to prevent breach and overflow—that is all.
translations.idiomatic: Where dikes along the old channel have failed, patch them lightly—only enough to prevent new breaches.

sentences.zh: 至於開河、進約等事，一切毋得興功，俟河勢稍定然後議。

translations.literal: As for opening channels, advancing constraints, and the like—let no such work be undertaken; wait until the river's force settles somewhat before debating further.
translations.idiomatic: As for opening new channels, advancing barriers, and the like—no such work should be undertaken until the river settles, when the matter can be debated again.

sentences.zh: 不過一月，漲水既落，則西流之勢，決無移理。

translations.literal: Within a month at most, once the flood falls, the westward current's force will certainly not shift.
translations.idiomatic: Within a month at most, once the flood subsides, the westward current will certainly not change course.

sentences.zh: 兼聞孫村出岸漲水，今已斷流，河上官吏未肯奏知耳。

translations.literal: I also hear that the Suncun flood over the banks has already broken off, but the river officials on site will not report it.
translations.idiomatic: I also hear that the Suncun overflow has already ceased, but the river officials on site refuse to report it.

sentences.zh: 是時，吳安持與李偉力主東流，而謝卿材謂「近歲河流稍行地中，無可回之理」，上《河議》一編。

translations.literal: At that time Wu Anchi and Li Wei strongly advocated the eastern flow, while Xie Qingcai said, "In recent years the river has run somewhat underground; there is no principle by which it can be turned back," and submitted a treatise 《On River Policy》.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wu Anchi and Li Wei strongly advocated forcing the eastern flow, while Xie Qingcai argued that "in recent years the river has run somewhat below ground and cannot be turned back," and submitted a treatise 《On River Policy》.

sentences.zh: 召赴政事堂會議，大臣不以為然。

translations.literal: He was summoned to the Council Chamber for discussion; the great ministers did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to the Council Chamber for discussion, but the senior ministers were not persuaded.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，三省、樞密院言：「繼日霖雨，河上之役，恐煩聖慮。」

translations.literal: On guichou the Three Departments and Privy Council reported: "Days of continuous rain follow one another; the river works may trouble the sage concerns."
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day the Three Departments and Privy Council reported: "Rain has fallen day after day; the river works may trouble Your Majesty's mind."

sentences.zh: 太后曰：「訪之外議，河水已東復故道矣。」

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager said: "Inquiring among outside opinion, the river water has already returned east to the old channel."
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager said: "According to outside opinion, the river has already returned east to its old channel."

sentences.zh: 乙丑，李偉言：「已開撥北京南沙河直堤第三鋪，放水入孫村口故道通行。」

translations.literal: On yichou Li Wei reported: "We have already opened the third post of the straight dike on the south Shahe at Beijing, releasing water into the old channel at Suncun mouth for passage."
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Li Wei reported: "We have opened the third post of the straight dike on Beijing's south Shahe, releasing water into the old channel at Suncun for passage."

sentences.zh: 又言：「大河已分流，即更不須開淘。

translations.literal: He also said: "The great river has already divided; dredging is no longer needed.
translations.idiomatic: He added: "The great river has already split in two; dredging is no longer needed.

sentences.zh: 因昨來一決之後，東流自是順快，渲刷漸成港道。

translations.literal: Since the breach last year, the eastern flow has naturally run swift and smooth; scouring has gradually formed a channel.
translations.idiomatic: Since last year's breach, the eastern flow has naturally grown swift; scouring has gradually carved out a channel.

sentences.zh: 見今已為二股，約奪大河三分以來，若得夫二萬，於九月興工，至十月寒凍時可畢。

translations.literal: Now it has become two channels, seizing roughly a third of the great river or more; if twenty thousand laborers can be obtained, work can begin in the ninth month and finish by the tenth month when the cold freezes.
translations.idiomatic: It is now two channels, drawing off roughly a third of the great river or more. With twenty thousand laborers, work could begin in the ninth month and finish before the cold sets in during the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 因引導河勢，豈止為二股通行而已，亦將遂為回奪大河之計。

translations.literal: By guiding the river's force, this is not only to let two channels run—it is also to proceed with the plan to seize back the great river.
translations.idiomatic: By guiding the river's force, the aim is not merely to keep two channels open but to proceed with the plan to win back the main current.

sentences.zh: 今來既因擗拶東流，修全鋸牙，當迤邐增進一埽，而取一埽之利，比至來年春、夏之交，遂可全復故道。

translations.literal: Now that the eastern flow has been forced by constraint, the saw-teeth barriers are fully repaired; one should advance revetment by revetment in succession, taking each revetment's advantage—by the turn of spring and summer next year the old channel can be wholly restored.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the eastern flow has been forced into place and the saw-tooth barriers are fully repaired, revetments should be advanced one after another, each gaining ground—by the turn of spring and summer next year the old channel can be wholly restored.

sentences.zh: 朝廷今日當極力必閉北流，乃為上策。

translations.literal: The court today must exert its utmost strength to close the northern flow—that is the superior policy.
translations.idiomatic: The court must now exert its full strength to shut the northern flow—that is the superior policy.

sentences.zh: 若不明詔有司，即令回河，深恐上下遷延，議終不決，觀望之間，遂失機會。

translations.literal: If the court does not issue a clear edict to the responsible offices ordering them to turn the river back, I deeply fear that above and below will delay, debate will never be settled, and in the interval of watching and waiting the opportunity will be lost.
translations.idiomatic: Without a clear edict ordering the responsible offices to turn the river back, I fear that court and provinces will delay, debate will never end, and the opportunity will be lost while all stand watching.

sentences.zh: 乞復置修河司。」

translations.literal: We beg to restore the Office for River Repair."
translations.idiomatic: We beg that the Office for River Repair be restored."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 五年正月丁亥，梁燾言：「朝廷治河，東流北流，本無一偏之私。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year on dinghai, Liang Tao stated: "In governing the river, eastern flow and northern flow—originally the court had no partial preference.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the first month in the fifth year, Liang Tao memorialized: "In governing the river, eastern flow and northern flow—the court originally held no partial preference.

sentences.zh: 今東流未成，邊北之州縣未至受患，其役可緩；

translations.literal: Now the eastern flow is not yet achieved; the border counties to the north have not yet suffered harm—the work can be slowed;
translations.idiomatic: The eastern flow is not yet secure; the northern border counties have not yet suffered harm—those works can wait;

sentences.zh: 北流方悍，邊西之州縣，日夕可憂，其備宜急。

translations.literal: the northern flow is fierce; the border counties to the west may suffer at any moment—the preparations should be urgent.
translations.idiomatic: but the northern flow is violent; the western border counties face danger at any moment—preparations there should be urgent.

sentences.zh: 今傾半天下之力，專事東流，而不加一夫一草於北流之上，得不誤國計乎！

translations.literal: Now half the empire's strength is poured solely into the eastern flow, without adding a single laborer or blade of grass to the northern flow—can this fail to mistake the national plan!
translations.idiomatic: Now half the empire's resources are poured solely into the eastern flow, without a single laborer or blade of grass devoted to the northern flow—can this fail to betray the national plan!

sentences.zh: 去年屢決之害，全由堤防無備。

translations.literal: Last year's repeated breach disasters all stemmed from unready dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's repeated breaches all stemmed from unready dikes.

sentences.zh: 臣願嚴責水官，修治北流埽岸，使二方均被惻隱之恩。」

translations.literal: I beg that water officials be strictly charged to repair the northern-flow revetments and banks so that both regions alike receive compassionate care."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that water officials be held strictly accountable to repair the northern-flow revetments and banks so that both regions alike receive the court's care."

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，詔開修減水河。

translations.literal: In the second month on jihai an edict ordered the flood-relief canal opened and repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the second month an edict ordered the flood-relief canal opened and repaired.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，乃詔三省、樞密院：「去冬愆雪，今未得雨，外路旱墻闊遠，宜權罷修河。」

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict went to the Three Departments and Privy Council: "Last winter snow was deficient; rain has not yet come; drought on the outer circuits is wide and severe—it is fitting temporarily to suspend river repair."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day an edict went to the Three Departments and Privy Council: "Last winter brought too little snow, and rain has not yet fallen. Drought on the outer circuits is wide and severe—river repair should be suspended for the time being."

sentences.zh: 戊申，蘇轍言：「臣去年使契丹，過河北，見州縣官吏，訪以河事，皆相視不敢正言。

translations.literal: On wushen Su Zhe stated: "Last year when I went on mission to the Khitan and passed through Hebei, I saw prefectural and county officials; when I asked about the river they looked at one another and dared not speak plainly.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Su Zhe memorialized: "Last year, on my mission to the Khitan, I passed through Hebei and questioned prefectural and county officials about the river. They looked at one another and dared not speak plainly.

sentences.zh: 及今年正月，還自契丹，所過吏民，方舉手相慶，皆言近有朝旨罷回河大役，命下之日，北京之人，歡呼鼓舞。

translations.literal: When I returned from the Khitan this first month, the officials and people I passed all raised their hands in celebration, saying that recently an imperial order had halted the great project to turn the river back; from the day the order arrived, the people of Beijing shouted and danced for joy.
translations.idiomatic: When I returned from the Khitan this first month, every official and commoner I met raised their hands in celebration, saying a recent imperial order had halted the great project to turn the river back. From the day the order arrived, the people of the Northern Capital shouted and danced for joy.

sentences.zh: 惟減水河役遷延不止，耗蠹之事，十存四五，民間竊議，意大臣業已為此，勢難遽回。

translations.literal: Only the flood-relief canal work drags on without end; of the wasteful expenses, four or five tenths remain. Among the people it is privately said that the great ministers have already committed to this and the momentum makes sudden reversal hard.
translations.idiomatic: Only the flood-relief canal work drags on; four or five tenths of the wasteful expense remains. People whisper that the senior ministers are already committed and the momentum makes sudden reversal difficult.

sentences.zh: 既為聖鑒所臨，要當迤邐盡罷。

translations.literal: Now that the sage gaze has fallen upon it, the work should be wound down step by step until fully halted.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the throne has taken notice, the work should be wound down step by step until it is fully halted.

sentences.zh: 今月六日，果蒙聖旨，以旱災為名，權罷修黃河，候今秋取旨。

translations.literal: On the sixth of this month we were indeed graced with an imperial order, in the name of drought disaster, temporarily suspending Yellow River repair, to await further instruction this autumn.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth of this month we were indeed graced with an imperial order, citing drought, temporarily suspending Yellow River repair until further instruction this autumn.

sentences.zh: 大臣覆奏盡罷黃河東、北流及諸河功役，民方憂旱，聞命踴躍，實荷聖恩。

translations.literal: The great ministers memorialized in reply to halt entirely the eastern flow, northern flow, and all river labor; the people, already anxious over drought, leaped at the order—truly they bore the sage grace.
translations.idiomatic: The senior ministers memorialized in reply to halt entirely the eastern flow, northern flow, and all river labor. The people, already anxious over drought, leaped at the order—they truly received the throne's grace.

sentences.zh: 然臣竊詳聖旨，上合天意，下合民心。

translations.literal: Yet I privately examine the imperial order—it matches Heaven above and the people's hearts below.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I examine the imperial order closely—it accords with Heaven above and the people's hearts below.

sentences.zh: 因水之性，功力易就，天語激切，中外聞者或至泣下，而臣奉行，不得其平。

translations.literal: Following the water's nature, the labor would be easy to finish; the heavenly words were urgent and cutting—some within and without wept on hearing them—yet in carrying them out I could not obtain fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Following the water's nature, the work would be easy to finish. The imperial words were urgent and piercing—some within and without wept on hearing them—yet in carrying them out I could not obtain fairness.

sentences.zh: 由此觀之，則是大臣所欲，雖害物而必行；

translations.literal: Viewed thus, what the great ministers desire, though it harms things, must be done;
translations.idiomatic: Viewed thus, what the senior ministers desire, though it harms the people, must be done;

sentences.zh: 陛下所為，雖利民而不聽。

translations.literal: what Your Majesty does, though it benefits the people, is not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: what Your Majesty orders, though it benefits the people, goes unheeded.

sentences.zh: 至於委曲回避，巧為之說，僅乃得行，君權已奪，國勢倒植。

translations.literal: As for evasive circumlocution and clever arguments, they barely secure execution; sovereign authority is already seized and the state's posture inverted.
translations.idiomatic: Through evasive circumlocution and clever arguments they barely secure execution. Sovereign authority is already usurped and the state's posture inverted.

sentences.zh: 臣所謂君臣之間，逆順之際，大為不便者，此事是也。

translations.literal: What I call the greatest inconvenience in the moment between ruler and minister, compliance and defiance—is precisely this matter.
translations.idiomatic: What I call the gravest breach between ruler and minister, between compliance and defiance—is precisely this matter.

sentences.zh: 黃河既不可復回，則先罷修河司，只令河北轉運司盡將一道兵功，修貼北流堤岸；

translations.literal: Since the Yellow River cannot be turned back, then first abolish the Office for River Repair and only order the Hebei transport commissioner to devote all labor in the circuit to repairing the northern-flow dikes;
translations.idiomatic: Since the Yellow River cannot be turned back, abolish the Office for River Repair first and order the Hebei transport commissioner to devote all circuit labor to repairing the northern-flow dikes;

sentences.zh: 罷吳安持、李偉都水監差遣，正其欺罔之罪，使天下曉然知聖意所在。

translations.literal: remove Wu Anchi and Li Wei from their waterways posts, correct their deceit, and let all under Heaven clearly know where the sage intent lies.
translations.idiomatic: remove Wu Anchi and Li Wei from their waterways posts, punish their deceit, and let all under Heaven clearly know where the throne's intent lies.

sentences.zh: 如此施行，不獨河事就緒，天下臣庶，自此不敢以虛誑欺朝廷，弊事庶幾漸去矣。」

translations.literal: If carried out thus, not only will the river affair be settled, but from this day forth subjects dare not use empty falsehood to deceive the court, and corrupt practices may gradually depart."
translations.idiomatic: If carried out thus, not only will the river affair be settled, but from this day forth no subject will dare deceive the court with empty falsehoods, and corrupt practices may gradually fade."

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，提舉東流故道李偉言：「大河自五月後日益暴漲，始由北京南沙堤第七鋪決口，水出於第三、第四鋪並清豐口一併東流。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on jiachen Li Wei, who was charged with the old eastern channel, stated: "Since the fifth month the great river has daily grown more violent; first it breached the seventh post of the south Shahe dike at Beijing, and water issued from the third and fourth posts together with Qingfeng mouth—all flowing east.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the eighth month Li Wei, charged with the old eastern channel, reported: "Since the fifth month the great river has grown more violent day by day. First it breached the seventh post of the south Shahe dike at Beijing; water then issued from the third and fourth posts together with Qingfeng mouth—all flowing east.

sentences.zh: 故道河槽深三丈至一丈以上，比去年尤為深快，頗減北流橫溢之患。

translations.literal: The old channel's bed is three zhang deep down to more than one zhang—deeper and swifter than last year—greatly reducing the northern flow's lateral overflow affliction.
translations.idiomatic: The old channel's bed is three zhang deep in places and more than one zhang elsewhere—deeper and swifter than last year—greatly reducing the northern flow's lateral flooding.

sentences.zh: 然今已秋深，水當減落，若不稍加措置，慮致斷絕，即東流遂成淤澱。

translations.literal: Yet now autumn is deep; the water should fall—if measures are not taken in slight degree, I fear it will break off and the eastern flow will become silted.
translations.idiomatic: Yet autumn is already deep and the water should subside. Without some measure, I fear the flow will break off and the eastern channel will silt up.

sentences.zh: 望下所屬官司，經畫沙堤等口分水利害，免淤故道，上誤國事。」

translations.literal: I hope the subordinate offices may plan the hydraulic harm at outlets such as the sand dike, prevent silting of the old channel, and not mislead the national affair above."
translations.idiomatic: I hope the responsible offices will plan the hydraulic risks at outlets such as the sand dike, prevent silting of the old channel, and not mislead the state."

sentences.zh: 詔吳安持與本路監司、北外丞司及李偉按視，具合措置事連書以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wu Anchi, with the circuit's supervisory commissioners, the northern outer assistant commissioners, and Li Wei to inspect on site, compile all measures that should be taken in a linked memorial, and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Wu Anchi, together with the circuit's supervisory commissioners, the northern outer assistant commissioners, and Li Wei, to inspect on site, compile all required measures in a joint memorial, and report.

sentences.zh: 九月，中丞蘇轍言：「修河司若不罷，李偉若不去，河水終不得順流，河朔生靈終不得安居。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Censor Su Zhe stated: "If the Office for River Repair is not abolished and Li Wei is not removed, the river water will never run in its proper course and the people of Hebei will never dwell in peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Censor Su Zhe memorialized: "If the Office for River Repair is not abolished and Li Wei is not removed, the river will never run true and the people of Hebei will never know peace.

sentences.zh: 乞速罷修河司，及檢舉六年四月庚子敕，竄責李偉。」

translations.literal: I beg urgently to abolish the Office for River Repair and, citing the edict of gengzi in the fourth month of the sixth year, punish Li Wei by exile."
translations.idiomatic: I beg urgently to abolish the Office for River Repair and, citing the edict of gengzi in the fourth month of the sixth year, punish Li Wei by exile."

sentences.zh: 七年三月，以吏部郎中趙偁權河北轉運使。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year Zhao Cheng of the Ministry of Personnel was appointed acting Hebei transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year Zhao Cheng of the Ministry of Personnel was appointed acting Hebei transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 偁素與安持等議不協，嘗上《河議》，其略曰：「自頃有司回河幾三年，功費騷動半天下，復為分水又四年矣。

translations.literal: Cheng had long disagreed with Anchi and others; he had once submitted 《On River Policy》, its gist saying: "For some time the responsible offices have sought to turn the river back for nearly three years, stirring labor and expense through half the empire; then dividing the water again for four years more.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng had long disagreed with Anchi and others. He had once submitted 《On River Policy》, which in gist said: "For some time the responsible offices have sought to turn the river back for nearly three years, stirring labor and expense through half the empire; then they divided the water again for four years more.

sentences.zh: 故所謂分水者，因河流、相地勢導而分之。

translations.literal: What is called dividing the water is to follow the river's flow and guide division according to the terrain.
translations.idiomatic: True division of the water means following the river's flow and guiding it apart according to the terrain.

sentences.zh: 今乃橫截河流，置埽約以扼之，開浚河門，徒為淵潭，其狀可見。

translations.literal: Now they cut across the river's flow, set revetments and constraints to choke it, and open dredged river mouths—only to make deep pools; the situation is plain to see.
translations.idiomatic: Now they cut across the river's flow, set revetments and barriers to choke it, and open dredged outlets—only to make deep pools. The situation is plain to see.

sentences.zh: 況故道千里，其間又有高處，故累歲漲落輒復自斷。

translations.literal: Moreover the old channel is a thousand li, and within it are also high places; thus year after year as floods rise and fall it breaks off again by itself.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the old channel runs a thousand li, and within it are high stretches; thus year after year, as floods rise and fall, it breaks off again by itself.

sentences.zh: 夫河流有逆順，地勢有高下，非朝廷可得而見，職在有司，朝廷任之亦信矣，患有司不自信耳。

translations.literal: The river's flow has contrary and conforming courses; the terrain has high and low—the court cannot see this; the duty lies with the responsible offices, and if the court entrusts them that is already trust enough—the affliction is that the responsible offices do not trust themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The river runs contrary or conforming; the terrain rises and falls—the court cannot see this for itself. The duty lies with the responsible offices, and entrusting them is trust enough—the trouble is that the responsible offices do not trust themselves.

sentences.zh: 臣謂當繕大河北流兩堤，復修宗城棄堤，閉宗城口，廢上、下約，開闞村河門，使河流湍直，以成深道。

translations.literal: I say we should repair the great river's northern-flow banks on both sides, restore the abandoned Zongcheng dike, close the Zongcheng mouth, abolish the upper and lower constraints, open the Kancun river mouth, and let the river run turbulent and straight to form a deep channel.
translations.idiomatic: I propose repairing the great river's northern-flow banks on both sides, restoring the abandoned Zongcheng dike, closing the Zongcheng outlet, abolishing the upper and lower barriers, opening the Kancun river mouth, and letting the river run swift and straight to form a deep channel.

sentences.zh: 聚三河工費以治一河，一二年可以就緒，而河患庶幾息矣。

translations.literal: Gather the labor expense of the three rivers to treat one river—in one or two years it can be finished, and the river affliction may roughly cease.
translations.idiomatic: Gather the labor expense of the three river projects to treat one river—in one or two years the work can be finished and the river scourge may roughly cease.

sentences.zh: 願以河事並都水條例一付轉運司，而總以工部，罷外丞司使，措置歸一，則職事可舉，弊事可去。」

translations.literal: I wish that river affairs and all waterways regulations be handed entirely to the transport commissioner, with overall charge to the Ministry of Works, abolishing the outer assistant commissioners so that arrangements are unified—then duties can be performed and corrupt practices removed."
translations.idiomatic: I wish that river affairs and all waterways regulations be handed entirely to the transport commissioner, with overall charge resting in the Ministry of Works, abolishing the outer assistant commissioners so that arrangements are unified—then duties can be performed and corrupt practices removed."

sentences.zh: 四月，詔：「南、北外兩丞司管下河埽，今後令河北、京西轉運使、副、判官、府界提點分認界至，內河北仍於銜內帶'兼管南北外都水公事'。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month an edict stated: "The river revetments under the northern and southern outer assistant commissioners—hereafter let the Hebei and Jingxi transport commissioners, vice commissioners, judicial commissioners, and metropolitan frontier intendant divide and acknowledge their boundaries; within Hebei still add to the title 'Concurrently in charge of northern and southern outer waterways affairs.'"
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict stated: "The river revetments under the northern and southern outer assistant commissioners—hereafter let the Hebei and Jingxi transport commissioners, vice commissioners, judicial commissioners, and metropolitan frontier intendant divide and acknowledge their boundaries. Within Hebei, their titles shall still include 'Concurrently in charge of northern and southern outer waterways affairs.'"

sentences.zh: 十月辛酉，以大河東流，賜都水使者吳安持三品服，北都水監丞李偉再任。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on xinyou, because the great river flowed east, Wu Anchi as waterways commissioner was granted third-rank robes and Li Wei was reappointed northern waterways assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the tenth month, because the great river flowed east, waterways commissioner Wu Anchi was granted third-rank robes and northern waterways assistant commissioner Li Wei was reappointed.
